TOOLS_ANALYTICS_TEXTS["ch"] = TOOLS_ANALYTICS_TEXTS["de"]


def tools_analytics_lang() -> str:
    idioma = st.session_state.get(
        "dashboard_interface_lang",
        "pt",
    )

    if idioma in TOOLS_ANALYTICS_TEXTS:
        return idioma

    return "pt"


def tools_analytics_t(
    key: str,
    default: str | None = None,
) -> str:
    idioma = tools_analytics_lang()

    return TOOLS_ANALYTICS_TEXTS.get(
        idioma,
        TOOLS_ANALYTICS_TEXTS["pt"],
    ).get(
        key,
        default or key,
    )


def formatar_delta_percentual(
    valor: float,
) -> str:
    """
    Formata variação percentual para exibição.
    """
    return f"{float(valor):+.2f}%"


def preparar_ranking_exibicao(
    ranking: pd.DataFrame | None,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Converte nomes técnicos em nomes amigáveis.
    """
    if ranking is None or ranking.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    tabela = ranking.copy()

    colunas = {
        "ferramenta": tools_analytics_t("tool"),
        "execucoes": tools_analytics_t("executions"),
        "sucessos": tools_analytics_t("successes"),
        "falhas": tools_analytics_t("failures"),
        "taxa_sucesso_percentual": tools_analytics_t(
            "success_rate"
        ),
        "confianca_media_percentual": tools_analytics_t(
            "average_confidence"
        ),
        "duracao_media_ms": tools_analytics_t(
            "average_ms"
        ),
        "duracao_minima_ms": tools_analytics_t(
            "minimum_ms"
        ),
        "duracao_maxima_ms": tools_analytics_t(
            "maximum_ms"
        ),
        "p50_ms": "P50 (ms)",
        "p95_ms": "P95 (ms)",
        "p99_ms": "P99 (ms)",
    }

    existentes = {
        coluna: nome
        for coluna, nome in colunas.items()
        if coluna in tabela.columns
    }

    return tabela[list(existentes)].rename(
        columns=existentes
    )


def render_comparacao_periodos(
    comparacao: dict[str, Any],
) -> None:
    """
    Exibe o período atual versus o anterior.
    """
    atual = comparacao.get(
        "periodo_atual",
        {},
    )

    anterior = comparacao.get(
        "periodo_anterior",
        {},
    )

    st.markdown(
        tools_analytics_t(
            "period_comparison"
        )
    )

    col_1, col_2, col_3 = st.columns(3)

    col_1.metric(
        tools_analytics_t("executions"),
        atual.get("execucoes", 0),
        delta=formatar_delta_percentual(
            comparacao.get(
                "variacao_execucoes_percentual",
                0,
            )
        ),
    )

    col_2.metric(
        tools_analytics_t("failures"),
        atual.get("falhas", 0),
        delta=formatar_delta_percentual(
            comparacao.get(
                "variacao_falhas_percentual",
                0,
            )
        ),
        delta_color="inverse",
    )

    col_3.metric(
        tools_analytics_t(
            "average_duration"
        ),
        (
            f"{float(atual.get('duracao_media_ms', 0)):.3f} ms"
        ),
        delta=formatar_delta_percentual(
            comparacao.get(
                "variacao_duracao_percentual",
                0,
            )
        ),
        delta_color="inverse",
    )

    with st.expander(
        tools_analytics_t(
            "detailed_comparison"
        ),
        expanded=False,
    ):
        tabela = pd.DataFrame([
            {
                tools_analytics_t("period"): (
                    tools_analytics_t("current")
                ),
                tools_analytics_t("executions"): atual.get(
                    "execucoes",
                    0,
                ),
                tools_analytics_t("failures"): atual.get(
                    "falhas",
                    0,
                ),
                tools_analytics_t(
                    "average_duration_ms"
                ): atual.get(
                    "duracao_media_ms",
                    0,
                ),
            },
            {
                tools_analytics_t("period"): (
                    tools_analytics_t("previous")
                ),
                tools_analytics_t("executions"): anterior.get(
                    "execucoes",
                    0,
                ),
                tools_analytics_t("failures"): anterior.get(
                    "falhas",
                    0,
                ),
                tools_analytics_t(
                    "average_duration_ms"
                ): anterior.get(
                    "duracao_media_ms",
                    0,
                ),
            },
        ])

        st.dataframe(
            tabela,
            use_container_width=True,
            hide_index=True,
        )


def render_anomalias_operacionais(
    resultado: dict[str, Any],
) -> None:
    """
    Renderiza alertas e métricas de anomalias.
    """
    st.markdown(
        tools_analytics_t("anomaly_detection")
    )

    if not resultado.get("tem_dados"):
        st.info(
            tools_analytics_t(
                "insufficient_anomaly_data"
            )
        )
        return

    anomalias = resultado.get(
        "anomalias",
        [],
    )

    total = int(
        resultado.get(
            "total_anomalias",
            0,
        )
    )

    maior_severidade = (
        resultado.get(
            "maior_severidade"
        )
        or tools_analytics_t("none")
    )

    atual = resultado.get(
        "periodo_atual",
        {},
    )

    base = resultado.get(
        "linha_base",
        {},
    )

    linha_1 = st.columns(4)

    linha_1[0].metric(
        tools_analytics_t("detected_anomalies"),
        total,
    )

    linha_1[1].metric(
        tools_analytics_t("highest_severity"),
        maior_severidade.title(),
    )

    linha_1[2].metric(
        tools_analytics_t("current_period_failures"),
        int(
            atual.get(
                "falhas",
                0,
            )
        ),
    )

    linha_1[3].metric(
        tools_analytics_t("current_p95"),
        (
            f"{float(atual.get('duracao_p95_ms', 0)):.3f} ms"
        ),
    )

    linha_2 = st.columns(4)

    linha_2[0].metric(
        tools_analytics_t("current_failure_rate"),
        (
            f"{float(atual.get('taxa_falhas_percentual', 0)):.2f}%"
        ),
    )

    linha_2[1].metric(
        tools_analytics_t("baseline_failure_rate"),
        (
            f"{float(base.get('taxa_falhas_percentual', 0)):.2f}%"
        ),
    )

    linha_2[2].metric(
        tools_analytics_t("current_confidence"),
        (
            f"{float(atual.get('confianca_media_percentual', 0)):.2f}%"
        ),
    )

    linha_2[3].metric(
        tools_analytics_t("baseline_confidence"),
        (
            f"{float(base.get('confianca_media_percentual', 0)):.2f}%"
        ),
    )

    if not anomalias:
        st.success(
            tools_analytics_t(
                "no_relevant_anomalies"
            )
        )
        return

    contagem_severidade = {
        "critica": 0,
        "alta": 0,
        "media": 0,
        "baixa": 0,
        "informativa": 0,
    }

    for item in anomalias:
        severidade = item.get(
            "severidade",
            "informativa",
        )

        contagem_severidade[
            severidade
        ] = (
            contagem_severidade.get(
                severidade,
                0,
            )
            + 1
        )

    st.markdown(
        tools_analytics_t("anomalies_by_severity")
    )

    colunas = st.columns(5)

    colunas[0].metric(
        tools_analytics_t("critical"),
        contagem_severidade["critica"],
    )

    colunas[1].metric(
        tools_analytics_t("high"),
        contagem_severidade["alta"],
    )

    colunas[2].metric(
        tools_analytics_t("medium"),
        contagem_severidade["media"],
    )

    colunas[3].metric(
        tools_analytics_t("low"),
        contagem_severidade["baixa"],
    )

    colunas[4].metric(
        tools_analytics_t("informational"),
        contagem_severidade[
            "informativa"
        ],
    )

    st.markdown(
        tools_analytics_t("detected_alerts")
    )

    for indice, item in enumerate(
        anomalias,
        start=1,
    ):
        severidade = item.get(
            "severidade",
            "informativa",
        )

        simbolo = {
            "critica": "🔴",
            "alta": "🟠",
            "media": "🟡",
            "baixa": "🔵",
            "informativa": "ℹ️",
        }.get(
            severidade,
            "ℹ️",
        )

        titulo = item.get(
            "titulo",
            tools_analytics_t("anomaly"),
        )

        with st.container(
            border=True
        ):
            st.markdown(
                f"### {simbolo} {indice}. {titulo}"
            )

            col_1, col_2, col_3 = st.columns(
                [2, 1, 1]
            )

            col_1.markdown(
                item.get(
                    "descricao",
                    "",
                )
            )

            col_2.metric(
                "Valor atual",
                item.get(
                    "valor_atual",
                    0,
                ),
            )

            col_3.metric(
                "Referência",
                item.get(
                    "valor_referencia",
                    0,
                ),
            )

            st.caption(
                f"{tools_analytics_t('severity')}: "
                f"{severidade.title()} | "
                f"{tools_analytics_t('metric')}: "
                f"{item.get('metrica', '')}"
            )

            st.info(
                f"{tools_analytics_t('recommendation')}: "
                + str(
                    item.get(
                        "recomendacao",
                        "",
                    )
                )
            )

    outliers = resultado.get(
        "outliers_duracao"
    )

    if (
        outliers is not None
        and not outliers.empty
    ):
        st.markdown(
            tools_analytics_t("outlier_executions")
        )

        tabela_outliers = (
            outliers.copy()
            .rename(
                columns={
                    "indice": tools_analytics_t(
                        "event_index"
                    ),
                    "valor": tools_analytics_t(
                        "duration_ms"
                    ),
                    "score_robusto": tools_analytics_t(
                        "modified_z_score"
                    ),
                }
            )
        )

        st.dataframe(
            tabela_outliers,
            use_container_width=True,
            hide_index=True,
        )

    with st.expander(
        tools_analytics_t(
            "how_detection_works"
        ),
        expanded=False,
    ):
        st.markdown(
            tools_analytics_t(
                "detection_explanation"
            )
        )


def render_tools_analytics_page() -> None:
    """
    Renderiza o Analytics Avançado das Tools.
    """
    try:
        from observability.analytics import (
            calcular_distribuicao_coluna,
            calcular_execucoes_sem_tool,
            calcular_ranking_tools,
            calcular_serie_temporal_analytics,
            comparar_periodos,
            preparar_eventos_analytics,
        )
        from tools.observability import (
            carregar_eventos_tools,
        )
    except ImportError:
        from src.observability.analytics import (
            calcular_distribuicao_coluna,
            calcular_execucoes_sem_tool,
            calcular_ranking_tools,
            calcular_serie_temporal_analytics,
            comparar_periodos,
            preparar_eventos_analytics,
        )
        from src.tools.observability import (
            carregar_eventos_tools,
        )

    st.title(
        tools_analytics_t("title")
    )

    st.caption(
        tools_analytics_t("caption")
    )

    controle_1, controle_2, controle_3 = st.columns(
        [1, 1, 2]
    )

    limite = controle_1.selectbox(
        tools_analytics_t("loaded_events"),
        options=[
            100,
            250,
            500,
            1000,
        ],
        index=1,
        key="tools_analytics_limit",
    )

    periodo_horas = controle_2.selectbox(
        tools_analytics_t("comparison_window"),
        options=[
            24,
            48,
            72,
            168,
        ],
        index=0,
        format_func=lambda valor: (
            f"{valor} {tools_analytics_t('hours')}"
            if valor < 168
            else tools_analytics_t("seven_days")
        ),
        key="tools_analytics_period",
    )

    with controle_3:
        st.write("")

        if st.button(
            tools_analytics_t("refresh"),
            use_container_width=True,
            key="tools_analytics_refresh",
        ):
            st.rerun()

    resultado = carregar_eventos_tools(
        limite=int(limite)
    )

    if not resultado.get("ok"):
        st.error(
            resultado.get(
                "message",
                tools_analytics_t("load_error"),
            )
        )
        return

    df = resultado.get("df")

    if df is None or df.empty:
        st.info(
            tools_analytics_t(
                "insufficient_events"
            )
        )
        return

    base = preparar_eventos_analytics(
        df
    )

    ranking = calcular_ranking_tools(
        base
    )

    sem_tool = calcular_execucoes_sem_tool(
        base
    )

    total_eventos = len(base)

    total_sucesso = int(
        base["sucesso"].sum()
        if "sucesso" in base.columns
        else 0
    )

    total_falhas = max(
        total_eventos - total_sucesso,
        0,
    )

    taxa_sucesso = (
        round(
            (
                total_sucesso
                / total_eventos
            )
            * 100,
            2,
        )
        if total_eventos
        else 0.0
    )

    confianca_media = (
        round(
            float(
                base["confianca"]
                .dropna()
                .mean()
            )
            * 100,
            2,
        )
        if (
            "confianca" in base.columns
            and base["confianca"].notna().any()
        )
        else 0.0
    )

    duracao_media = (
        round(
            float(
                base["duracao_ms"]
                .dropna()
                .mean()
            ),
            3,
        )
        if (
            "duracao_ms" in base.columns
            and base["duracao_ms"].notna().any()
        )
        else 0.0
    )

    try:
        from observability.narrative import (
            gerar_insights_operacionais,
            gerar_texto_narrativa,
        )
    except ImportError:
        from src.observability.narrative import (
            gerar_insights_operacionais,
            gerar_texto_narrativa,
        )

    insights = gerar_insights_operacionais(
        base,
        horas_comparacao=int(periodo_horas),
    )

    st.markdown(
        tools_analytics_t(
            "operational_insights"
        )
    )

    saude = insights.get(
        "saude",
        {},
    )

    col_saude_1, col_saude_2 = st.columns(
        [1, 3]
    )

    col_saude_1.metric(
        tools_analytics_t("health_score"),
        f"{saude.get('score', 0):.1f}/100",
    )

    col_saude_2.info(
        insights.get(
            "resumo_executivo",
            tools_analytics_t("no_summary"),
        )
    )

    col_insight_1, col_insight_2 = st.columns(2)

    with col_insight_1:
        st.markdown(
            tools_analytics_t("highlights")
        )

        for item in insights.get(
            "destaques",
            [],
        ):
            st.success(item)

    with col_insight_2:
        st.markdown(
            tools_analytics_t("alerts")
        )

        alertas = insights.get(
            "alertas",
            [],
        )

        if alertas:
            for item in alertas:
                st.warning(item)
        else:
            st.success(
                tools_analytics_t(
                    "no_critical_alert"
                )
            )

    with st.expander(
        tools_analytics_t(
            "technical_recommendations"
        ),
        expanded=False,
    ):
        for item in insights.get(
            "recomendacoes",
            [],
        ):
            st.markdown(
                f"- {item}"
            )

    with st.expander(
        tools_analytics_t(
            "full_narrative"
        ),
        expanded=False,
    ):
        st.markdown(
            gerar_texto_narrativa(
                insights
            )
        )

    st.divider()

    try:
        from observability.anomalies import (
            detectar_anomalias_operacionais,
        )
    except ImportError:
        from src.observability.anomalies import (
            detectar_anomalias_operacionais,
        )

    resultado_anomalias = (
        detectar_anomalias_operacionais(
            base,
            horas_periodo_atual=int(
                periodo_horas
            ),
            horas_linha_base=168,
        )
    )

    render_anomalias_operacionais(
        resultado_anomalias
    )

    st.divider()

    st.markdown(
        tools_analytics_t(
            "analytic_overview"
        )
    )

    linha_1 = st.columns(4)

    linha_1[0].metric(
        tools_analytics_t(
            "analysed_events"
        ),
        total_eventos,
    )

    linha_1[1].metric(
        tools_analytics_t(
            "success_rate_metric"
        ),
        f"{taxa_sucesso:.2f}%",
    )

    linha_1[2].metric(
        tools_analytics_t("failures"),
        total_falhas,
    )

    linha_1[3].metric(
        tools_analytics_t(
            "executions_without_tool"
        ),
        (
            f"{sem_tool['total']} "
            f"({sem_tool['percentual']:.2f}%)"
        ),
    )

    linha_2 = st.columns(4)

    linha_2[0].metric(
        tools_analytics_t(
            "average_confidence_metric"
        ),
        f"{confianca_media:.2f}%",
    )

    linha_2[1].metric(
        tools_analytics_t(
            "average_duration_metric"
        ),
        f"{duracao_media:.3f} ms",
    )

    linha_2[2].metric(
        tools_analytics_t(
            "distinct_tools"
        ),
        (
            int(
                base["tool_exibicao"]
                .nunique()
            )
            if "tool_exibicao" in base.columns
            else 0
        ),
    )

    linha_2[3].metric(
        tools_analytics_t(
            "unique_users"
        ),
        (
            int(
                base["usuario_id"]
                .dropna()
                .nunique()
            )
            if "usuario_id" in base.columns
            else 0
        ),
    )

    comparacao = comparar_periodos(
        base,
        horas=int(periodo_horas),
    )

    render_comparacao_periodos(
        comparacao
    )

    st.divider()
    st.markdown(
        tools_analytics_t(
            "ranking_performance"
        )
    )

    ranking_exibicao = preparar_ranking_exibicao(
        ranking
    )

    if ranking_exibicao.empty:
        st.info(
            tools_analytics_t(
                "no_tool_found"
            )
        )
    else:
        st.dataframe(
            ranking_exibicao,
            use_container_width=True,
            hide_index=True,
        )

        col_grafico_1, col_grafico_2 = st.columns(2)

        with col_grafico_1:
            st.markdown(
                tools_analytics_t(
                    "usage_by_tool"
                )
            )

            ranking_uso = (
                ranking[
                    [
                        "ferramenta",
                        "execucoes",
                    ]
                ]
                .copy()
                .sort_values(
                    "execucoes",
                    ascending=True,
                )
            )

            fig_uso_tools = px.bar(
                ranking_uso,
                x="execucoes",
                y="ferramenta",
                orientation="h",
                text="execucoes",
                color="execucoes",
                color_continuous_scale=[
                    "#172554",
                    "#2563EB",
                    "#38BDF8",
                ],
            )

            fig_uso_tools.update_traces(
                texttemplate="%{x:,.0f}",
                textposition="outside",
                cliponaxis=False,
                marker_line_width=0,
                hovertemplate=(
                    "<b>%{y}</b><br>"
                    + tools_analytics_t(
                        "executions_hover"
                    )
                    + ": %{x:,.0f}"
                    "<extra></extra>"
                ),
            )

            fig_uso_tools.update_layout(
                xaxis_title=tools_analytics_t(
                    "executions"
                ),
                yaxis_title=None,
                coloraxis_showscale=False,
                showlegend=False,
            )

            aplicar_tema_tools_analytics_chart(
                fig_uso_tools,
                height=max(
                    380,
                    120 + len(ranking_uso) * 46,
                ),
            )

            st.plotly_chart(
                fig_uso_tools,
                width="stretch",
                key="tools_analytics_usage_chart",
                config={
                    "displayModeBar": False,
                    "responsive": True,
                },
            )

        with col_grafico_2:
            st.markdown(
                tools_analytics_t(
                    "p95_by_tool"
                )
            )

            ranking_p95 = (
                ranking[
                    [
                        "ferramenta",
                        "p95_ms",
                    ]
                ]
                .copy()
                .fillna({
                    "p95_ms": 0,
                })
                .sort_values(
                    "p95_ms",
                    ascending=True,
                )
            )

            fig_p95_tools = px.bar(
                ranking_p95,
                x="p95_ms",
                y="ferramenta",
                orientation="h",
                text="p95_ms",
                color="p95_ms",
                color_continuous_scale=[
                    "#312E81",
                    "#7C3AED",
                    "#F59E0B",
                ],
            )

            fig_p95_tools.update_traces(
                texttemplate="%{x:,.0f} ms",
                textposition="outside",
                cliponaxis=False,
                marker_line_width=0,
                hovertemplate=(
                    "<b>%{y}</b><br>"
                    "P95: %{x:,.2f} ms"
                    "<extra></extra>"
                ),
            )

            fig_p95_tools.update_layout(
                xaxis_title=tools_analytics_t(
                    "p95_latency"
                ),
                yaxis_title=None,
                coloraxis_showscale=False,
                showlegend=False,
            )

            aplicar_tema_tools_analytics_chart(
                fig_p95_tools,
                height=max(
                    380,
                    120 + len(ranking_p95) * 46,
                ),
            )

            st.plotly_chart(
                fig_p95_tools,
                width="stretch",
                key="tools_analytics_p95_chart",
                config={
                    "displayModeBar": False,
                    "responsive": True,
                },
            )

    st.divider()
    st.markdown(
        tools_analytics_t("distributions")
    )

    col_dist_1, col_dist_2 = st.columns(2)

    distribuicao_intencoes = (
        calcular_distribuicao_coluna(
            base,
            "intencao",
        )
    )

    distribuicao_origens = (
        calcular_distribuicao_coluna(
            base,
            "origem",
        )
    )

    with col_dist_1:
        st.markdown(
            tools_analytics_t("intentions")
        )

        if not distribuicao_intencoes.empty:
            tabela_intencoes = (
                distribuicao_intencoes.rename(
                    columns={
                        "intencao": tools_analytics_t(
                            "intention"
                        ),
                        "total": tools_analytics_t(
                            "total"
                        ),
                    }
                )
            )

            st.dataframe(
                tabela_intencoes,
                use_container_width=True,
                hide_index=True,
            )

            intencoes_grafico = (
                distribuicao_intencoes.copy()
                .sort_values(
                    "total",
                    ascending=True,
                )
            )

            fig_intencoes = px.bar(
                intencoes_grafico,
                x="total",
                y="intencao",
                orientation="h",
                text="total",
                color="total",
                color_continuous_scale=[
                    "#164E63",
                    "#0891B2",
                    "#22D3EE",
                ],
            )

            fig_intencoes.update_traces(
                texttemplate="%{x:,.0f}",
                textposition="outside",
                cliponaxis=False,
                marker_line_width=0,
                hovertemplate=(
                    "<b>%{y}</b><br>"
                    + tools_analytics_t("events")
                    + ": %{x:,.0f}"
                    "<extra></extra>"
                ),
            )

            fig_intencoes.update_layout(
                xaxis_title=tools_analytics_t(
                    "events"
                ),
                yaxis_title=None,
                coloraxis_showscale=False,
                showlegend=False,
            )

            aplicar_tema_tools_analytics_chart(
                fig_intencoes,
                height=max(
                    360,
                    120 + len(intencoes_grafico) * 44,
                ),
            )

            st.plotly_chart(
                fig_intencoes,
                width="stretch",
                key="tools_analytics_intentions_chart",
                config={
                    "displayModeBar": False,
                    "responsive": True,
                },
            )

    with col_dist_2:
        st.markdown(
            tools_analytics_t("origins")
        )

        if not distribuicao_origens.empty:
            tabela_origens = (
                distribuicao_origens.rename(
                    columns={
                        "origem": tools_analytics_t(
                            "origin"
                        ),
                        "total": tools_analytics_t(
                            "total"
                        ),
                    }
                )
            )

            st.dataframe(
                tabela_origens,
                use_container_width=True,
                hide_index=True,
            )

            origens_grafico = (
                distribuicao_origens.copy()
                .sort_values(
                    "total",
                    ascending=True,
                )
            )

            fig_origens = px.bar(
                origens_grafico,
                x="total",
                y="origem",
                orientation="h",
                text="total",
                color="total",
                color_continuous_scale=[
                    "#312E81",
                    "#7C3AED",
                    "#A78BFA",
                ],
            )

            fig_origens.update_traces(
                texttemplate="%{x:,.0f}",
                textposition="outside",
                cliponaxis=False,
                marker_line_width=0,
                hovertemplate=(
                    "<b>%{y}</b><br>"
                    + tools_analytics_t("events")
                    + ": %{x:,.0f}"
                    "<extra></extra>"
                ),
            )

            fig_origens.update_layout(
                xaxis_title=tools_analytics_t(
                    "events"
                ),
                yaxis_title=None,
                coloraxis_showscale=False,
                showlegend=False,
            )

            aplicar_tema_tools_analytics_chart(
                fig_origens,
                height=max(
                    360,
                    120 + len(origens_grafico) * 44,
                ),
            )

            st.plotly_chart(
                fig_origens,
                width="stretch",
                key="tools_analytics_origins_chart",
                config={
                    "displayModeBar": False,
                    "responsive": True,
                },
            )

    st.divider()
    st.markdown(
        tools_analytics_t(
            "temporal_evolution"
        )
    )

    frequency_options = (
        "hour",
        "day",
        "week",
        "month",
    )

    frequency_labels = {
        "hour": tools_analytics_t("hour"),
        "day": tools_analytics_t("day"),
        "week": tools_analytics_t("week"),
        "month": tools_analytics_t("month"),
    }

    frequencia_label = st.radio(
        tools_analytics_t("grouping"),
        options=frequency_options,
        format_func=lambda value: (
            frequency_labels[value]
        ),
        horizontal=True,
        key="tools_analytics_frequency",
    )

    mapa_frequencia = {
        "hour": "h",
        "day": "D",
        "week": "W",
        "month": "ME",
    }

    serie = calcular_serie_temporal_analytics(
        base,
        mapa_frequencia[
            frequencia_label
        ],
    )

    if serie.empty:
        st.info(
            tools_analytics_t(
                "insufficient_time_series"
            )
        )
    else:
        serie_grafico = serie.copy()

        period_column = tools_analytics_t(
            "period_label"
        )

        serie_grafico[period_column] = (
            pd.to_datetime(
                serie_grafico["criado_em"],
                errors="coerce",
            )
            .dt.strftime(
                "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M"
            )
        )

        serie_plot = (
            serie_grafico[
                [
                    period_column,
                    "execucoes",
                    "sucessos",
                    "falhas",
                ]
            ]
            .rename(
                columns={
                    "execucoes": tools_analytics_t(
                        "executions"
                    ),
                    "sucessos": tools_analytics_t(
                        "successful_executions"
                    ),
                    "falhas": tools_analytics_t(
                        "failed_executions"
                    ),
                }
            )
        )

        fig_evolucao = px.line(
            serie_plot,
            x=period_column,
            y=[
                tools_analytics_t("executions"),
                tools_analytics_t(
                    "successful_executions"
                ),
                tools_analytics_t(
                    "failed_executions"
                ),
            ],
            markers=True,
            color_discrete_sequence=[
                "#38BDF8",
                "#34D399",
                "#F87171",
            ],
        )

        fig_evolucao.update_traces(
            line={
                "width": 3,
            },
            marker={
                "size": 7,
            },
            hovertemplate=(
                "<b>%{x}</b><br>"
                "%{fullData.name}: %{y:,.0f}"
                "<extra></extra>"
            ),
        )

        fig_evolucao.update_layout(
            xaxis_title=None,
            yaxis_title=tools_analytics_t(
                "events"
            ),
            legend_title_text=None,
            hovermode="x unified",
            legend={
                "orientation": "h",
                "yanchor": "bottom",
                "y": 1.02,
                "xanchor": "center",
                "x": 0.5,
            },
        )

        fig_evolucao.update_yaxes(
            rangemode="tozero",
        )

        aplicar_tema_tools_analytics_chart(
            fig_evolucao,
            height=450,
        )

        st.plotly_chart(
            fig_evolucao,
            width="stretch",
            key="tools_analytics_evolution_chart",
            config={
                "displayModeBar": False,
                "responsive": True,
            },
        )

        st.dataframe(
            serie_grafico,
            use_container_width=True,
            hide_index=True,
        )

    st.divider()
    st.markdown(
        tools_analytics_t(
            "most_active_users"
        )
    )

    usuarios = (
        base["usuario_id"]
        .fillna(
            tools_analytics_t("no_user")
        )
        .value_counts()
        .rename_axis(
            tools_analytics_t("user")
        )
        .reset_index(
            name=tools_analytics_t("executions")
        )
    )

    usuarios_grafico = usuarios.sort_values(
        tools_analytics_t("executions"),
        ascending=True,
    ).copy()

    fig_usuarios = px.bar(
        usuarios_grafico,
        x=tools_analytics_t("executions"),
        y=tools_analytics_t("user"),
        orientation="h",
        text=tools_analytics_t("executions"),
        color=tools_analytics_t("executions"),
        color_continuous_scale=[
            "#064E3B",
            "#059669",
            "#34D399",
        ],
    )

    fig_usuarios.update_traces(
        texttemplate="%{x:,.0f}",
        textposition="outside",
        cliponaxis=False,
        marker_line_width=0,
        hovertemplate=(
            "<b>%{y}</b><br>"
            + tools_analytics_t("executions")
            + ": %{x:,.0f}"
            "<extra></extra>"
        ),
    )

    fig_usuarios.update_layout(
        xaxis_title=tools_analytics_t(
            "executions"
        ),
        yaxis_title=None,
        coloraxis_showscale=False,
        showlegend=False,
    )

    aplicar_tema_tools_analytics_chart(
        fig_usuarios,
        height=max(
            380,
            120 + len(usuarios_grafico) * 44,
        ),
    )

    st.plotly_chart(
        fig_usuarios,
        width="stretch",
        key="tools_analytics_active_users_chart",
        config={
            "displayModeBar": False,
            "responsive": True,
        },
    )

    st.dataframe(
        usuarios,
        use_container_width=True,
        hide_index=True,
    )

def tools_observability_lang() -> str:
    language = st.session_state.get(
        "dashboard_interface_lang",
        "pt",
    )

    aliases = {
        "en": "en_us",
        "en-US": "en_us",
        "en-GB": "en_gb",
        "English (US)": "en_us",
        "English (UK)": "en_gb",
    }

    language = aliases.get(
        str(language),
        str(language),
    )

    if language in TOOLS_OBSERVABILITY_TEXTS:
        return language

    return "pt"


def tools_observability_t(
    key: str,
    default: str | None = None,
) -> str:
    language = tools_observability_lang()

    language_texts = TOOLS_OBSERVABILITY_TEXTS.get(
        language,
        {},
    )

    if key in language_texts:
        return language_texts[key]

    portuguese_texts = TOOLS_OBSERVABILITY_TEXTS["pt"]

    if key in portuguese_texts:
        return portuguese_texts[key]

    if default is not None:
        return default

    return key



def aplicar_tema_tools_observability_chart(
    fig,
    *,
    height=420,
):
    """Aplica o tema visual da Observabilidade Tools."""
    fig.update_layout(
        template="plotly_dark",
        paper_bgcolor=TOOLS_OBSERVABILITY_BG,
        plot_bgcolor=TOOLS_OBSERVABILITY_BG,
        font={
            "color": TOOLS_OBSERVABILITY_TEXT,
            "family": "Arial",
        },
        hoverlabel={
            "bgcolor": "#0F172A",
            "font_color": TOOLS_OBSERVABILITY_TEXT,
        },
        margin={
            "l": 30,
            "r": 42,
            "t": 18,
            "b": 38,
        },
        height=height,
    )

    fig.update_xaxes(
        color=TOOLS_OBSERVABILITY_TEXT,
        gridcolor=TOOLS_OBSERVABILITY_GRID,
        zerolinecolor=(
            "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25)"
        ),
    )

    fig.update_yaxes(
        color=TOOLS_OBSERVABILITY_TEXT,
        gridcolor=TOOLS_OBSERVABILITY_GRID,
        zerolinecolor=(
            "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25)"
        ),
    )

    return fig

def tools_translate_dynamic(
    value: Any,
) -> str:
    if value is None or pd.isna(value):
        return ""

    original = str(value).strip()
    key = TOOLS_DYNAMIC_KEYS.get(
        original
    )

    if key is None:
        return original

    language = tools_observability_lang()

    texts = TOOLS_DYNAMIC_TEXTS.get(
        language,
        TOOLS_DYNAMIC_TEXTS["pt"],
    )

    return texts.get(
        key,
        original,
    )


def calcular_taxa_sucesso(
    total_sucesso: int,
    total_executadas: int,
) -> float:
    if total_executadas <= 0:
        return 0.0

    return round(
        (total_sucesso / total_executadas) * 100,
        2,
    )


def preparar_ranking_tools(
    df: pd.DataFrame | None,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    base = df.copy()

    base["tool_label"] = (
        base["tool_label"]
        .fillna(base["tool_nome"])
        .fillna("Sem Tool")
    )

    ranking = (
        base.groupby("tool_label")
        .agg(
            Execuções=("id", "count"),
            Sucessos=("sucesso", "sum"),
            Falhas=(
                "sucesso",
                lambda valores: int(
                    (~valores.astype(bool)).sum()
                ),
            ),
            Média_ms=("duracao_ms", "mean"),
            Mínimo_ms=("duracao_ms", "min"),
            Máximo_ms=("duracao_ms", "max"),
        )
        .reset_index()
        .rename(
            columns={
                "tool_label": "Ferramenta",
            }
        )
    )

    ranking["Ferramenta"] = ranking[
        "Ferramenta"
    ].map(
        tools_translate_dynamic
    )

    ranking["Taxa de sucesso (%)"] = ranking.apply(
        lambda row: calcular_taxa_sucesso(
            int(row["Sucessos"]),
            int(row["Execuções"]),
        ),
        axis=1,
    )

    for coluna in [
        "Média_ms",
        "Mínimo_ms",
        "Máximo_ms",
    ]:
        ranking[coluna] = (
            ranking[coluna]
            .fillna(0)
            .round(3)
        )

    return ranking.sort_values(
        by=["Execuções", "Taxa de sucesso (%)"],
        ascending=[False, False],
    ).reset_index(drop=True)


def preparar_serie_temporal(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    frequencia: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if df.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    temporal = df.copy()

    temporal["criado_em"] = pd.to_datetime(
        temporal["criado_em"],
        errors="coerce",
        utc=True,
    )

    temporal = temporal.dropna(
        subset=["criado_em"]
    )

    if frequencia == "Hora":
        temporal["Período"] = (
            temporal["criado_em"]
            .dt.floor("h")
            .dt.strftime("%d/%m %H:00")
        )
    else:
        temporal["Período"] = (
            temporal["criado_em"]
            .dt.floor("D")
            .dt.strftime("%d/%m/%Y")
        )

    return (
        temporal.groupby("Período")
        .agg(
            Execuções=("id", "count"),
            Sucessos=("sucesso", "sum"),
            Duração_média_ms=(
                "duracao_ms",
                "mean",
            ),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )


def preparar_eventos_exibicao(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if df.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    tabela = df.copy()

    tabela["Ferramenta"] = (
        tabela["tool_label"]
        .fillna(tabela["tool_nome"])
        .fillna(
            tools_observability_t(
                "no_tool"
            )
        )
        .map(
            tools_translate_dynamic
        )
    )

    if "mensagem" in tabela.columns:
        tabela["mensagem"] = tabela[
            "mensagem"
        ].map(
            tools_translate_dynamic
        )

    tabela["Status"] = tabela["sucesso"].map({
        True: tools_observability_t(
            "success"
        ),
        False: tools_observability_t(
            "failure"
        ),
    })

    tabela["Confiança"] = (
        tabela["confianca"]
        .fillna(0)
        .apply(
            lambda valor: f"{float(valor) * 100:.0f}%"
        )
    )

    tabela["Duração"] = (
        tabela["duracao_ms"]
        .fillna(0)
        .apply(
            lambda valor: f"{float(valor):.3f} ms"
        )
    )

    tabela["Data"] = pd.to_datetime(
        tabela["criado_em"],
        errors="coerce",
    ).dt.strftime("%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S")

    colunas = [
        "Data",
        "usuario_id",
        "pergunta",
        "Ferramenta",
        "intencao",
        "Confiança",
        "Status",
        "Duração",
        "origem",
        "mensagem",
        "erro",
    ]

    return tabela[
        [
            coluna
            for coluna in colunas
            if coluna in tabela.columns
        ]
    ].rename(
        columns={
            "usuario_id": "Usuário",
            "pergunta": "Pergunta",
            "intencao": "Intenção",
            "origem": "Origem",
            "mensagem": "Mensagem",
            "erro": "Erro",
        }
    )


def gerar_excel(
    df_eventos: pd.DataFrame,
    df_ranking: pd.DataFrame,
) -> bytes:
    output = BytesIO()

    with pd.ExcelWriter(
        output,
        engine="openpyxl",
    ) as writer:
        df_eventos.to_excel(
            writer,
            sheet_name=tools_observability_t("events"),
            index=False,
        )

        df_ranking.to_excel(
            writer,
            sheet_name="Ranking",
            index=False,
        )

    return output.getvalue()


def render_metricas_executivas(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> dict:
    """
    Renderiza os KPIs executivos do Operations Center.
    """
    metricas = calcular_metricas_executivas(
        df
    )

    st.markdown(tools_observability_t("executive_view"))

    linha_1 = st.columns(4)

    linha_1[0].metric(
        tools_observability_t("registered_events"),
        metricas["total_eventos"],
    )

    linha_1[1].metric(
        tools_observability_t("executions_today"),
        metricas["execucoes_hoje"],
    )

    linha_1[2].metric(
        tools_observability_t("last_24_hours"),
        metricas["execucoes_ultimas_24h"],
    )

    linha_1[3].metric(
        tools_observability_t("active_users"),
        metricas["usuarios_ativos"],
    )

    linha_2 = st.columns(4)

    linha_2[0].metric(
        tools_observability_t("success_rate"),
        (
            f"{metricas['taxa_sucesso_percentual']:.2f}%"
        ),
    )

    linha_2[1].metric(
        tools_observability_t("successful_executions"),
        metricas["total_sucesso"],
    )

    linha_2[2].metric(
        tools_observability_t("failures"),
        metricas["total_falhas"],
    )

    linha_2[3].metric(
        tools_observability_t("average_confidence"),
        (
            f"{metricas['confianca_media_percentual']:.2f}%"
        ),
    )

    linha_3 = st.columns(4)

    linha_3[0].metric(
        tools_observability_t("average_duration"),
        (
            f"{metricas['duracao_media_ms']:.3f} ms"
        ),
    )

    linha_3[1].metric(
        tools_observability_t("minimum_duration"),
        (
            f"{metricas['duracao_minima_ms']:.3f} ms"
        ),
    )

    linha_3[2].metric(
        tools_observability_t("p95_duration"),
        (
            f"{metricas['duracao_p95_ms']:.3f} ms"
        ),
        help=tools_observability_t(
            "p95_help"
        ),
    )

    linha_3[3].metric(
        tools_observability_t("maximum_duration"),
        (
            f"{metricas['duracao_maxima_ms']:.3f} ms"
        ),
    )

    tool_top = metricas.get(
        "tool_mais_utilizada",
        {},
    )

    ultima_execucao = metricas.get(
        "ultima_execucao"
    )

    col_destaque_1, col_destaque_2 = st.columns(2)

    with col_destaque_1:
        st.markdown(tools_observability_t("most_used_tool"))

        if tool_top.get("nome"):
            st.success(
                tools_translate_dynamic(
                    tool_top["nome"]
                )
                + " — "
                + tools_observability_t(
                    "execution_count"
                ).format(
                    count=tool_top["total"]
                )
            )
        else:
            st.info(
                tools_observability_t(
                    "no_dominant_tool"
                )
            )

    with col_destaque_2:
        st.markdown(tools_observability_t("last_execution"))

        if ultima_execucao:
            data_formatada = pd.to_datetime(
                ultima_execucao,
                errors="coerce",
            )

            if pd.notna(data_formatada):
                st.info(
                    data_formatada.strftime(
                        "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S"
                    )
                )
            else:
                st.info(str(ultima_execucao))
        else:
            st.info(
                tools_observability_t(
                    "no_execution"
                )
            )

    return metricas


def render_status_infraestrutura(
    resultado_status: dict[str, Any],
) -> None:
    st.markdown(tools_observability_t("infrastructure_state"))

    status = resultado_status.get(
        "status",
        {},
    )

    total = resultado_status.get(
        "total_componentes",
        0,
    )

    operacionais = resultado_status.get(
        "total_operacionais",
        0,
    )

    st.progress(
        operacionais / total
        if total
        else 0
    )

    st.caption(
        tools_observability_t(
            "operational_components"
        ).format(
            operational=operacionais,
            total=total,
        )
    )

    colunas = st.columns(3)

    for indice, item in enumerate(
        status.values()
    ):
        coluna = colunas[
            indice % len(colunas)
        ]

        simbolo = "🟢" if item["ok"] else "🔴"

        label_traduzido = (
            tools_translate_dynamic(
                item["label"]
            )
        )

        mensagem_traduzida = (
            tools_translate_dynamic(
                item["message"]
            )
        )

        coluna.markdown(
            f"**{simbolo} {label_traduzido}**"
        )

        coluna.caption(
            mensagem_traduzida
        )


def render_tools_observability_page() -> None:
    try:
        from tools.observability import (
            carregar_eventos_tools,
            carregar_resumo_tools,
            carregar_status_infraestrutura,
        )
    except ImportError:
        from src.tools.observability import (
            carregar_eventos_tools,
            carregar_resumo_tools,
            carregar_status_infraestrutura,
        )

    st.title(tools_observability_t("page_title"))

    st.caption(
        tools_observability_t(
            "page_caption"
        )
    )

    controle_1, controle_2, controle_3 = st.columns(
        [1, 1, 2]
    )

    limite = controle_1.selectbox(
        tools_observability_t(
            "loaded_events"
        ),
        [50, 100, 250, 500, 1000],
        index=1,
    )

    frequencia_id = controle_2.selectbox(
        tools_observability_t(
            "time_grouping"
        ),
        ["hour", "day"],
        format_func=lambda value: (
            tools_observability_t(value)
        ),
    )

    frequencia = (
        "Hora"
        if frequencia_id == "hour"
        else "Dia"
    )

    with controle_3:
        st.write("")

        if st.button(
            tools_observability_t(
                "refresh"
            ),
            use_container_width=True,
        ):
            st.rerun()

    resumo_resultado = carregar_resumo_tools()
    eventos_resultado = carregar_eventos_tools(
        limite=int(limite)
    )

    if not resumo_resultado.get("ok"):
        st.error(resumo_resultado["message"])
        return

    if not eventos_resultado.get("ok"):
        st.error(eventos_resultado["message"])
        return

    df = eventos_resultado.get("df")

    if df is None:
        df = pd.DataFrame()

    render_metricas_executivas(
        df
    )

    st.divider()

    status_resultado = (
        carregar_status_infraestrutura()
    )

    render_status_infraestrutura(
        status_resultado
    )

    if df.empty:
        st.info(
            tools_observability_t(
                "no_events"
            )
        )
        return

    st.divider()
    st.markdown(tools_observability_t("search_filters"))

    pesquisa = st.text_input(
        tools_observability_t(
            "search_label"
        ),
        placeholder=tools_observability_t(
            "search_placeholder"
        ),
    )

    filtro_1, filtro_2, filtro_3 = st.columns(3)

    ferramentas = sorted(
        df["tool_label"]
        .fillna(df["tool_nome"])
        .dropna()
        .unique()
        .tolist()
    )

    origens = sorted(
        df["origem"]
        .dropna()
        .unique()
        .tolist()
    )

    usuarios = sorted(
        df["usuario_id"]
        .dropna()
        .unique()
        .tolist()
    )

    ferramenta = filtro_1.selectbox(
        tools_observability_t("tool"),
        ["__all__"] + ferramentas,
        format_func=lambda value: (
            tools_observability_t(
                "all_feminine"
            )
            if value == "__all__"
            else tools_translate_dynamic(
                value
            )
        ),
    )

    origem = filtro_2.selectbox(
        tools_observability_t("origin"),
        ["__all__"] + origens,
        format_func=lambda value: (
            tools_observability_t(
                "all_feminine"
            )
            if value == "__all__"
            else value
        ),
    )

    usuario = filtro_3.selectbox(
        tools_observability_t("user"),
        ["__all__"] + usuarios,
        format_func=lambda value: (
            tools_observability_t(
                "all_masculine"
            )
            if value == "__all__"
            else value
        ),
    )

    status = st.radio(
        tools_observability_t("status"),
        ["all", "success", "failure"],
        format_func=lambda value: (
            tools_observability_t(
                {
                    "all": "all_masculine",
                    "success": "success",
                    "failure": "failure",
                }[value]
            )
        ),
        horizontal=True,
    )

    filtrado = df.copy()

    if pesquisa.strip():
        termo = pesquisa.strip().lower()

        colunas_busca = [
            coluna
            for coluna in [
                "usuario_id",
                "pergunta",
                "tool_nome",
                "tool_label",
                "intencao",
            ]
            if coluna in filtrado.columns
        ]

        mascara = pd.Series(
            False,
            index=filtrado.index,
        )

        for coluna in colunas_busca:
            mascara = mascara | (
                filtrado[coluna]
                .fillna("")
                .astype(str)
                .str.lower()
                .str.contains(
                    termo,
                    regex=False,
                )
            )

        filtrado = filtrado[mascara]

    labels = filtrado[
        "tool_label"
    ].fillna(
        filtrado["tool_nome"]
    )

    if ferramenta != "__all__":
        filtrado = filtrado[
            labels == ferramenta
        ]

    if origem != "__all__":
        filtrado = filtrado[
            filtrado["origem"] == origem
        ]

    if usuario != "__all__":
        filtrado = filtrado[
            filtrado["usuario_id"] == usuario
        ]

    if status == "success":
        filtrado = filtrado[
            filtrado["sucesso"].eq(True)
        ]

    elif status == "failure":
        filtrado = filtrado[
            filtrado["sucesso"].eq(False)
        ]

    st.caption(
        tools_observability_t(
            "events_found"
        ).format(
            count=len(filtrado)
        )
    )

    st.divider()
    st.markdown(tools_observability_t("temporal_evolution"))

    serie_temporal = preparar_serie_temporal(
        filtrado,
        frequencia,
    )

    if not serie_temporal.empty:
        serie_grafico = (
            serie_temporal[
                [
                    "Período",
                    "Execuções",
                    "Sucessos",
                ]
            ]
            .copy()
        )

        period_label = tools_observability_t(
            "period"
        )
        executions_label = tools_observability_t(
            "executions"
        )
        successes_label = tools_observability_t(
            "successes"
        )

        serie_grafico = serie_grafico.rename(
            columns={
                "Período": period_label,
                "Execuções": executions_label,
                "Sucessos": successes_label,
            }
        )

        fig_evolucao = px.line(
            serie_grafico,
            x=period_label,
            y=[
                executions_label,
                successes_label,
            ],
            markers=True,
            color_discrete_sequence=[
                "#38BDF8",
                "#34D399",
            ],
        )

        fig_evolucao.update_traces(
            line={
                "width": 3,
            },
            marker={
                "size": 8,
            },
            hovertemplate=(
                "<b>%{x}</b><br>"
                "%{fullData.name}: %{y:,.0f}"
                "<extra></extra>"
            ),
        )

        fig_evolucao.update_layout(
            xaxis_title=None,
            yaxis_title=tools_observability_t(
                "events"
            ),
            legend_title_text=None,
            hovermode="x unified",
            legend={
                "orientation": "h",
                "yanchor": "bottom",
                "y": 1.02,
                "xanchor": "center",
                "x": 0.5,
            },
        )

        fig_evolucao.update_yaxes(
            rangemode="tozero",
        )

        aplicar_tema_tools_observability_chart(
            fig_evolucao,
            height=440,
        )

        st.plotly_chart(
            fig_evolucao,
            width="stretch",
            key="tools_observability_evolution_chart",
            config={
                "displayModeBar": False,
                "responsive": True,
            },
        )

    st.divider()
    st.markdown(tools_observability_t("tool_performance"))

    ranking = preparar_ranking_tools(
        filtrado
    )

    if not ranking.empty:
        ranking_exibicao = ranking.rename(
            columns={
                "Ferramenta": tools_observability_t(
                    "tool"
                ),
                "Execuções": tools_observability_t(
                    "executions"
                ),
                "Sucessos": tools_observability_t(
                    "successes"
                ),
                "Falhas": tools_observability_t(
                    "failures"
                ),
                "Média_ms": tools_observability_t(
                    "average_ms"
                ),
                "Mínimo_ms": tools_observability_t(
                    "minimum_ms"
                ),
                "Máximo_ms": tools_observability_t(
                    "maximum_ms"
                ),
                "Taxa de sucesso (%)": (
                    tools_observability_t(
                        "success_rate_column"
                    )
                ),
            }
        )

        st.dataframe(
            ranking_exibicao,
            use_container_width=True,
            hide_index=True,
        )

        tool_label = tools_observability_t(
            "tool"
        )
        executions_label = tools_observability_t(
            "executions"
        )

        ranking_grafico = (
            ranking[
                [
                    "Ferramenta",
                    "Execuções",
                ]
            ]
            .copy()
            .rename(
                columns={
                    "Ferramenta": tool_label,
                    "Execuções": executions_label,
                }
            )
            .sort_values(
                executions_label,
                ascending=True,
            )
        )

        fig_performance = px.bar(
            ranking_grafico,
            x=executions_label,
            y=tool_label,
            orientation="h",
            text=executions_label,
            color=executions_label,
            color_continuous_scale=[
                "#172554",
                "#2563EB",
                "#38BDF8",
            ],
        )

        fig_performance.update_traces(
            texttemplate="%{x:,.0f}",
            textposition="outside",
            cliponaxis=False,
            marker_line_width=0,
            hovertemplate=(
                "<b>%{y}</b><br>"
                + tools_observability_t(
                    "executions"
                )
                + ": %{x:,.0f}"
                "<extra></extra>"
            ),
        )

        fig_performance.update_layout(
            xaxis_title=tools_observability_t(
                "executions"
            ),
            yaxis_title=None,
            coloraxis_showscale=False,
            showlegend=False,
        )

        aplicar_tema_tools_observability_chart(
            fig_performance,
            height=max(
                390,
                130 + len(ranking_grafico) * 46,
            ),
        )

        st.plotly_chart(
            fig_performance,
            width="stretch",
            key="tools_observability_performance_chart",
            config={
                "displayModeBar": False,
                "responsive": True,
            },
        )

    st.divider()
    st.markdown(tools_observability_t("active_users_title"))

    user_label = tools_observability_t(
        "user"
    )
    executions_label = tools_observability_t(
        "executions"
    )

    usuarios_ranking = (
        filtrado["usuario_id"]
        .fillna(
            tools_observability_t(
                "no_user"
            )
        )
        .value_counts()
        .rename_axis(user_label)
        .reset_index(
            name=executions_label
        )
    )

    usuarios_grafico = (
        usuarios_ranking.copy()
        .sort_values(
            executions_label,
            ascending=True,
        )
    )

    fig_usuarios = px.bar(
        usuarios_grafico,
        x=executions_label,
        y=user_label,
        orientation="h",
        text=executions_label,
        color=executions_label,
        color_continuous_scale=[
            "#064E3B",
            "#059669",
            "#34D399",
        ],
    )

    fig_usuarios.update_traces(
        texttemplate="%{x:,.0f}",
        textposition="outside",
        cliponaxis=False,
        marker_line_width=0,
        hovertemplate=(
            "<b>%{y}</b><br>"
            + tools_observability_t(
                "executions"
            )
            + ": %{x:,.0f}"
            "<extra></extra>"
        ),
    )

    fig_usuarios.update_layout(
        xaxis_title=tools_observability_t(
            "executions"
        ),
        yaxis_title=None,
        coloraxis_showscale=False,
        showlegend=False,
    )

    aplicar_tema_tools_observability_chart(
        fig_usuarios,
        height=max(
            380,
            130 + len(usuarios_grafico) * 44,
        ),
    )

    st.plotly_chart(
        fig_usuarios,
        width="stretch",
        key="tools_observability_active_users_chart",
        config={
            "displayModeBar": False,
            "responsive": True,
        },
    )

    st.divider()
    st.markdown(tools_observability_t("searchable_history"))

    tabela = preparar_eventos_exibicao(
        filtrado
    ).rename(
        columns={
            "Data": tools_observability_t(
                "date"
            ),
            "Usuário": tools_observability_t(
                "user"
            ),
            "Pergunta": tools_observability_t(
                "question"
            ),
            "Ferramenta": tools_observability_t(
                "tool"
            ),
            "Intenção": tools_observability_t(
                "intention"
            ),
            "Confiança": tools_observability_t(
                "confidence"
            ),
            "Status": tools_observability_t(
                "status"
            ),
            "Duração": tools_observability_t(
                "duration"
            ),
            "Origem": tools_observability_t(
                "origin"
            ),
            "Mensagem": tools_observability_t(
                "message"
            ),
            "Erro": tools_observability_t(
                "error"
            ),
        }
    )

    st.dataframe(
        tabela,
        use_container_width=True,
        hide_index=True,
    )

    st.divider()
    st.markdown(tools_observability_t("export_data"))

    export_1, export_2, export_3 = st.columns(3)

    csv_bytes = tabela.to_csv(
        index=False,
    ).encode("utf-8-sig")

    export_1.download_button(
        tools_observability_t("export_csv"),
        data=csv_bytes,
        file_name="inna_tools_eventos.csv",
        mime="text/csv",
        use_container_width=True,
    )

    json_bytes = json.dumps(
        filtrado.to_dict(
            orient="records"
        ),
        ensure_ascii=False,
        indent=2,
        default=str,
    ).encode("utf-8")

    export_2.download_button(

        data=json_bytes,
        file_name="inna_tools_eventos.json",

    excel_bytes = gerar_excel(

def aplicar_tema_health_chart(
    fig,
    *,
    height=410,
):
    """Aplica o tema visual do INNA Health Center."""
    fig.update_layout(
        template="plotly_dark",
        paper_bgcolor=HEALTH_CHART_BG,
        plot_bgcolor=HEALTH_CHART_BG,
        font={
            "color": HEALTH_CHART_TEXT,
            "family": "Arial",
        },
        hoverlabel={
            "bgcolor": "#0F172A",
            "font_color": HEALTH_CHART_TEXT,
        },
        margin={
            "l": 28,
            "r": 28,
            "t": 18,
            "b": 28,
        },
        height=height,
    )

    fig.update_xaxes(
        color=HEALTH_CHART_TEXT,
        gridcolor=HEALTH_CHART_GRID,
        zerolinecolor=(
            "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25)"
        ),
    )

    fig.update_yaxes(
        color=HEALTH_CHART_TEXT,
        gridcolor=HEALTH_CHART_GRID,
        zerolinecolor=(
            "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25)"
        ),
    )

    return fig

HEALTH_TABLE_TEXTS["en_gb"] = (
    HEALTH_TABLE_TEXTS["en_us"]
)

HEALTH_TABLE_TEXTS["ch"] = (
    HEALTH_TABLE_TEXTS["de"]
)


def health_table_lang() -> str:
    """Retorna o idioma atual do Dashboard."""
    idioma = st.session_state.get(
        "dashboard_interface_lang",
        "pt",
    )

    if idioma in HEALTH_TABLE_TEXTS:
        return idioma

    return "pt"


def health_table_t(
    key: str,
    default: str | None = None,
) -> str:
    """Traduz textos das tabelas do Health Center."""
    idioma = health_table_lang()

    return HEALTH_TABLE_TEXTS.get(
        idioma,
        HEALTH_TABLE_TEXTS["pt"],
    ).get(
        key,
        default or key,
    )


def nome_componente_health(
    nome: str,
    padrao: str | None = None,
) -> str:
    """Traduz nomes de componentes sem alterar dados internos."""
    chaves = {
        "tools": "tools",
        "rag": "rag",
        "memoria": "memory",
        "infraestrutura": "infrastructure",
        "timeline": "timeline",
        "performance": "performance",
    }

    chave = chaves.get(
        str(nome or "").strip().lower()
    )

    if chave is None:
        return (
            padrao
            if padrao is not None
            else str(nome or "").title()
        )

    return health_table_t(
        chave,
        padrao,
    )


def health_date_format() -> str:
    """Formato de data conforme o idioma."""
    if health_table_lang() == "en_us":
        return "MM/DD/YYYY HH:mm"

    return "DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm"
