LLM_COST_PAGE_LOWER_TEXTS["en_gb"] = (
    LLM_COST_PAGE_LOWER_TEXTS["en_us"]
)

LLM_COST_PAGE_LOWER_TEXTS["ch"] = (
    LLM_COST_PAGE_LOWER_TEXTS["de"]
)

for language_key, lower_texts in (
    LLM_COST_PAGE_LOWER_TEXTS.items()
):
    LLM_COST_PAGE_TEXTS.setdefault(
        language_key,
        {},
    ).update(lower_texts)


def llm_cost_page_t(
    key: str,
    default: str | None = None,
) -> str:
    """Traduz título e legenda da página."""
    idioma = llm_table_lang()

    return LLM_COST_PAGE_TEXTS.get(
        idioma,
        LLM_COST_PAGE_TEXTS["pt"],
    ).get(
        key,
        default or key,
    )


def render_llm_costs_page() -> None:
    """
    Renderiza o LLM Cost Center.
    """
    try:
        from observability.llm_costs import (
            carregar_consumo_llm,
        )
    except ImportError:
        from src.observability.llm_costs import (
            carregar_consumo_llm,
        )

    st.title(
        llm_cost_page_t("title")
    )

    st.caption(
        llm_cost_page_t("caption")
    )

    controle_1, controle_2, controle_3 = (
        st.columns(
            [1, 1, 2]
        )
    )

    period_keys = [
        "period_1_day",
        "period_7_days",
        "period_30_days",
        "period_90_days",
        "period_all",
    ]

    periodo_key = controle_1.selectbox(
        llm_cost_page_t("period"),
        options=period_keys,
        format_func=llm_cost_page_t,
        index=2,
        key="llm_cost_period",
    )

    limite = controle_2.selectbox(
        llm_cost_page_t("event_limit"),
        options=[
            100,
            250,
            500,
            1000,
            5000,
        ],
        index=3,
        key="llm_cost_limit",
    )

    with controle_3:
        st.write("")

        if st.button(
            llm_cost_page_t("refresh"),
            use_container_width=True,
            key="llm_cost_refresh",
        ):
            st.rerun()

    periodos = {
        "period_1_day": 1,
        "period_7_days": 7,
        "period_30_days": 30,
        "period_90_days": 90,
        "period_all": None,
    }

    resultado = carregar_consumo_llm(
        limite=int(limite),
        dias=periodos[periodo_key],
    )

    if not resultado.get("ok"):
        st.error(
            resultado.get(
                "message",
                llm_cost_page_t("load_error"),
            )
        )
        return

    base = preparar_consumo_exibicao(
        resultado.get("df")
    )

    if base.empty:
        st.info(
            llm_cost_page_t("no_events")
        )
        return

    modelos = sorted(
        base["modelo"]
        .dropna()
        .astype(str)
        .unique()
        .tolist()
    )

    operacoes = sorted(
        base["operacao"]
        .dropna()
        .astype(str)
        .unique()
        .tolist()
    )

    filtro_1, filtro_2 = st.columns(2)

    modelos_escolhidos = filtro_1.multiselect(
        llm_cost_page_t("models"),
        options=modelos,
        default=modelos,
        key="llm_cost_models",
    )

    operacoes_escolhidas = filtro_2.multiselect(
        llm_cost_page_t("operations"),
        options=operacoes,
        default=operacoes,
        key="llm_cost_operations",
    )

    filtrado = base[
        base["modelo"].isin(
            modelos_escolhidos
        )
        & base["operacao"].isin(
            operacoes_escolhidas
        )
    ].copy()

    resumo = resumir_consumo_llm(
        filtrado
    )

    st.markdown(
        llm_cost_page_t("overview")
    )

    linha_1 = st.columns(5)

    linha_1[0].metric(
        llm_cost_page_t("calls"),
        resumo["eventos"],
    )

    linha_1[1].metric(
        llm_cost_page_t("total_tokens"),
        f"{resumo['tokens_totais']:,}".replace(
            ",",
            ".",
        ),
    )

    linha_1[2].metric(
        llm_cost_page_t("input_tokens"),
        f"{resumo['tokens_entrada']:,}".replace(
            ",",
            ".",
        ),
    )

    linha_1[3].metric(
        llm_cost_page_t("output_tokens"),
        f"{resumo['tokens_saida']:,}".replace(
            ",",
            ".",
        ),
    )

    linha_1[4].metric(
        llm_cost_page_t("estimated_cost"),
        (
            f"US$ "
            f"{resumo['custo_total_usd']:.6f}"
        ),
    )

    linha_2 = st.columns(4)

    linha_2[0].metric(
        llm_cost_page_t("success_rate"),
        f"{resumo['taxa_sucesso']:.2f}%",
    )

    linha_2[1].metric(
        llm_cost_page_t("average_duration"),
        (
            f"{resumo['duracao_media_ms'] / 1000:.2f} s"
        ),
    )

    linha_2[2].metric(
        "P95",
        (
            f"{resumo['duracao_p95_ms'] / 1000:.2f} s"
        ),
    )

    chamadas_lentas = int(
        (
            filtrado["duracao_ms"]
            >= 30000
        ).sum()
    )

    linha_2[3].metric(
        llm_cost_page_t("slow_calls"),
        chamadas_lentas,
    )

    if resumo["custo_total_usd"] == 0:
        st.warning(
            llm_cost_page_t(
                "prices_not_configured"
            )
        )

    if chamadas_lentas > 0:
        st.warning(
            llm_cost_page_t(
                "slow_calls_warning"
            ).format(
                count=chamadas_lentas
            )
        )

    st.divider()
    st.markdown(
        llm_cost_page_t("finops_budget")
    )

    try:
        from observability.llm_finops import (
            analisar_finops_llm,
        )
    except ImportError:
        from src.observability.llm_finops import (
            analisar_finops_llm,
        )

    finops = analisar_finops_llm(
        filtrado
    )

    config_finops = finops[
        "configuracao"
    ]

    situacao = finops[
        "situacao_orcamento"
    ]

    situacao_projecao = finops[
        "situacao_projecao"
    ]

    finops_cols = st.columns(5)

    finops_cols[0].metric(
        llm_cost_page_t("accumulated_cost"),
        (
            f"R$ "
            f"{finops['custo_acumulado_brl']:.4f}"
        ),
    )

    finops_cols[1].metric(
        llm_cost_page_t("average_cost_call"),
        (
            f"R$ "
            f"{finops['custo_medio_chamada_brl']:.4f}"
        ),
    )

    finops_cols[2].metric(
        llm_cost_page_t("monthly_projection"),
        (
            f"R$ "
            f"{finops['projecao_mensal_brl']:.2f}"
        ),
    )

    finops_cols[3].metric(
        llm_cost_page_t("monthly_budget"),
        (
            f"R$ "
            f"{config_finops['orcamento_mensal_brl']:.2f}"
        ),
    )

    finops_cols[4].metric(
        llm_cost_page_t("budget_usage"),
        (
            f"{situacao['percentual_utilizado']:.2f}%"
        ),
    )

    percentual_barra = max(
        0.0,
        min(
            situacao[
                "percentual_utilizado"
            ] / 100,
            1.0,
        ),
    )

    st.progress(
        percentual_barra
    )

    mensagem_orcamento = (
        f"{situacao['icone']} "
        f"{situacao['classificacao']}. "
        f"{llm_cost_page_t('estimated_balance')}: US$ "
        f"{situacao['saldo']:.4f}."
    )

    if situacao["status"] in {
        "critico",
        "excedido",
    }:
        st.error(
            mensagem_orcamento
        )

    elif situacao["status"] == "alerta":
        st.warning(
            mensagem_orcamento
        )

    else:
        st.success(
            mensagem_orcamento
        )

    if situacao_projecao["status"] in {
        "critico",
        "excedido",
    }:
        st.warning(
            llm_cost_page_t(
                "projection_warning"
            )
        )

    with st.expander(
        llm_cost_page_t(
            "finops_recommendations"
        ),
        expanded=False,
    ):
        for recomendacao in finops[
            "recomendacoes"
        ]:
            st.markdown(
                f"- {recomendacao}"
            )

        st.caption(
            llm_cost_page_t(
                "conversion_caption"
            ).format(
                rate=config_finops[
                    "cotacao_usd_brl"
                ]
            )
        )

    render_alertas_llm_section(
        base_consumo=filtrado,
        finops=finops,
    )

    st.divider()
    st.markdown(
        llm_cost_page_t(
            "consumption_by_model"
        )
    )

    por_modelo = (
        filtrado.groupby(
            "modelo",
            as_index=False,
        )
        .agg(
            Chamadas=("id", "count"),
            Tokens=("tokens_totais", "sum"),
            Custo_USD=(
                "custo_total_usd",
                "sum",
            ),
            Duracao_media_ms=(
                "duracao_ms",
                "mean",
            ),
        )
    )

    por_modelo[
        "Duração média (s)"
    ] = (
        por_modelo[
            "Duracao_media_ms"
        ]
        / 1000
    ).round(2)

    coluna_modelo = llm_table_t("model")
    coluna_chamadas = llm_table_t("calls")
    coluna_tokens = llm_table_t("tokens")
    coluna_custo = llm_table_t("cost_usd")
    coluna_duracao = llm_table_t(
        "avg_duration"
    )

    tabela_modelos = (
        por_modelo[
            [
                "modelo",
                "Chamadas",
                "Tokens",
                "Custo_USD",
                "Duração média (s)",
            ]
        ]
        .sort_values(
            "Tokens",
            ascending=False,
        )
        .rename(
            columns={
                "modelo": coluna_modelo,
                "Chamadas": coluna_chamadas,
                "Tokens": coluna_tokens,
                "Custo_USD": coluna_custo,
                "Duração média (s)": (
                    coluna_duracao
                ),
            }
        )
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )

    st.dataframe(
        estilizar_tabela_llm_costs(
            tabela_modelos
        ),
        use_container_width=True,
        hide_index=True,
        height=300,
        column_config={
            coluna_modelo: (
                st.column_config.TextColumn(
                    coluna_modelo,
                    help=llm_table_t(
                        "model_help"
                    ),
                    width="large",
                )
            ),
            coluna_chamadas: (
                st.column_config.NumberColumn(
                    coluna_chamadas,
                    help=llm_table_t(
                        "calls_help"
                    ),
                    format="%d",
                    width="small",
                )
            ),
            coluna_tokens: (
                st.column_config.ProgressColumn(
                    coluna_tokens,
                    help=llm_table_t(
                        "tokens_help"
                    ),
                    min_value=0,
                    max_value=max(
                        int(
                            tabela_modelos[
                                coluna_tokens
                            ].max()
                        ),
                        1,
                    ),
                    format="%d",
                    width="medium",
                )
            ),
            coluna_custo: (
                st.column_config.NumberColumn(
                    coluna_custo,
                    help=llm_table_t(
                        "cost_help"
                    ),
                    format="US$ %.6f",
                    width="medium",
                )
            ),
            coluna_duracao: (
                st.column_config.NumberColumn(
                    coluna_duracao,
                    help=llm_table_t(
                        "duration_help"
                    ),
                    format="%.2f s",
                    width="medium",
                )
            ),
        },
    )

    modelos_grafico = por_modelo.sort_values(
        "Tokens",
        ascending=True,
    ).copy()

    fig_modelos = px.bar(
        modelos_grafico,
        x="Tokens",
        y="modelo",
        orientation="h",
        text="Tokens",
        color="Tokens",
        color_continuous_scale=[
            "#172554",
            "#2563EB",
            "#38BDF8",
        ],
    )

    fig_modelos.update_traces(
        texttemplate="%{x:,.0f}",
        textposition="outside",
        cliponaxis=False,
        marker_line_width=0,
        hovertemplate=(
            "<b>%{y}</b><br>"
            "Tokens: %{x:,.0f}"
            "<extra></extra>"
        ),
    )

    fig_modelos.update_layout(
        xaxis_title=llm_cost_page_t(
            "consumed_tokens"
        ),
        yaxis_title=None,
        coloraxis_showscale=False,
        showlegend=False,
    )

    aplicar_tema_llm_cost_chart(
        fig_modelos,
        height=410,
    )

    st.plotly_chart(
        fig_modelos,
        width="stretch",
        key="llm_tokens_by_model_chart",
        config={
            "displayModeBar": False,
            "responsive": True,
        },
    )

    st.markdown(
        llm_cost_page_t(
            "consumption_by_operation"
        )
    )

    por_operacao = (
        filtrado.groupby(
            "operacao",
            as_index=False,
        )
        .agg(
            Chamadas=("id", "count"),
            Tokens=("tokens_totais", "sum"),
            Custo_USD=(
                "custo_total_usd",
                "sum",
            ),
            Duracao_media_ms=(
                "duracao_ms",
                "mean",
            ),
        )
    )

    por_operacao[
        "Duração média (s)"
    ] = (
        por_operacao[
            "Duracao_media_ms"
        ]
        / 1000
    ).round(2)

    coluna_operacao = llm_table_t("operation")
    coluna_chamadas = llm_table_t("calls")
    coluna_tokens = llm_table_t("tokens")
    coluna_custo = llm_table_t("cost_usd")
    coluna_duracao = llm_table_t(
        "avg_duration"
    )

    tabela_operacoes = (
        por_operacao[
            [
                "operacao",
                "Chamadas",
                "Tokens",
                "Custo_USD",
                "Duração média (s)",
            ]
        ]
        .sort_values(
            "Tokens",
            ascending=False,
        )
        .rename(
            columns={
                "operacao": coluna_operacao,
                "Chamadas": coluna_chamadas,
                "Tokens": coluna_tokens,
                "Custo_USD": coluna_custo,
                "Duração média (s)": (
                    coluna_duracao
                ),
            }
        )
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )

    st.dataframe(
        estilizar_tabela_llm_costs(
            tabela_operacoes
        ),
        use_container_width=True,
        hide_index=True,
        height=330,
        column_config={
            coluna_operacao: (
                st.column_config.TextColumn(
                    coluna_operacao,
                    help=llm_table_t(
                        "operation_help"
                    ),
                    width="large",
                )
            ),
            coluna_chamadas: (
                st.column_config.NumberColumn(
                    coluna_chamadas,
                    help=llm_table_t(
                        "calls_help"
                    ),
                    format="%d",
                    width="small",
                )
            ),
            coluna_tokens: (
                st.column_config.ProgressColumn(
                    coluna_tokens,
                    help=llm_table_t(
                        "tokens_help"
                    ),
                    min_value=0,
                    max_value=max(
                        int(
                            tabela_operacoes[
                                coluna_tokens
                            ].max()
                        ),
                        1,
                    ),
                    format="%d",
                    width="medium",
                )
            ),
            coluna_custo: (
                st.column_config.NumberColumn(
                    coluna_custo,
                    help=llm_table_t(
                        "cost_help"
                    ),
                    format="US$ %.6f",
                    width="medium",
                )
            ),
            coluna_duracao: (
                st.column_config.NumberColumn(
                    coluna_duracao,
                    help=llm_table_t(
                        "duration_help"
                    ),
                    format="%.2f s",
                    width="medium",
                )
            ),
        },
    )

    st.divider()
    st.markdown(
        llm_cost_page_t(
            "temporal_evolution"
        )
    )

    temporal = filtrado.copy()

    temporal["data"] = (
        temporal["criado_em"]
        .dt.floor("h")
    )

    serie_tokens = (
        temporal.groupby(
            "data",
            as_index=False,
        )["tokens_totais"]
        .sum()
        .rename(
            columns={
                "data": "Data",
                "tokens_totais": "Tokens",
            }
        )
        .set_index("Data")
    )

    st.markdown(
        llm_cost_page_t(
            "tokens_per_hour"
        )
    )

    fig_tokens = px.line(
        serie_tokens.reset_index(),
        x="Data",
        y="Tokens",
        markers=True,
        color_discrete_sequence=[
            "#38BDF8",
        ],
    )

    fig_tokens.update_traces(
        line={
            "width": 3,
        },
        marker={
            "size": 8,
            "color": "#E0F2FE",
            "line": {
                "color": "#38BDF8",
                "width": 2,
            },
        },
        fill="tozeroy",
        fillcolor="rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.16)",
        hovertemplate=(
            "<b>%{x|%d/%m/%Y %H:%M}</b><br>"
            "Tokens: %{y:,.0f}"
            "<extra></extra>"
        ),
    )

    fig_tokens.update_layout(
        xaxis_title=None,
        yaxis_title="Tokens",
        showlegend=False,
        hovermode="x unified",
    )

    aplicar_tema_llm_cost_chart(
        fig_tokens,
        height=420,
    )

    st.plotly_chart(
        fig_tokens,
        width="stretch",
        key="llm_tokens_by_hour_chart",
        config={
            "displayModeBar": False,
            "responsive": True,
        },
    )

    serie_duracao = (
        temporal.groupby(
            "data",
            as_index=False,
        )["duracao_ms"]
        .mean()
    )

    serie_duracao[
        "Duração média (s)"
    ] = (
        serie_duracao[
            "duracao_ms"
        ]
        / 1000
    )

    serie_duracao = (
        serie_duracao[
            [
                "data",
                "Duração média (s)",
            ]
        ]
        .rename(
            columns={
                "data": "Data",
            }
        )
        .set_index("Data")
    )

    st.markdown(
        llm_cost_page_t(
            "average_duration_per_hour"
        )
    )

    fig_duracao = px.line(
        serie_duracao.reset_index(),
        x="Data",
        y="Duração média (s)",
        markers=True,
        color_discrete_sequence=[
            "#A78BFA",
        ],
    )

    fig_duracao.update_traces(
        line={
            "width": 3,
        },
        marker={
            "size": 8,
            "color": "#F3E8FF",
            "line": {
                "color": "#A78BFA",
                "width": 2,
            },
        },
        hovertemplate=(
            "<b>%{x|%d/%m/%Y %H:%M}</b><br>"
            f"{llm_cost_page_t('average_duration_hover')}: "
            "%{y:.2f} s"
            "<extra></extra>"
        ),
    )

    fig_duracao.update_layout(
        xaxis_title=None,
        yaxis_title=llm_cost_page_t(
            "average_duration_seconds"
        ),
        showlegend=False,
        hovermode="x unified",
    )

    fig_duracao.update_yaxes(
        rangemode="tozero",
    )

    aplicar_tema_llm_cost_chart(
        fig_duracao,
        height=420,
    )

    st.plotly_chart(
        fig_duracao,
        width="stretch",
        key="llm_average_duration_by_hour_chart",
        config={
            "displayModeBar": False,
            "responsive": True,
        },
    )

    st.divider()
    st.markdown(
        llm_cost_page_t(
            "calls_audit"
        )
    )

    tabela = filtrado[
        [
            "id",
            "criado_em",
            "provider",
            "modelo",
            "operacao",
            "origem",
            "usuario_id",
            "trace_id",
            "tokens_entrada",
            "tokens_saida",
            "tokens_totais",
            "custo_total_usd",
            "duracao_ms",
            "sucesso",
            "erro_tipo",
        ]
    ].copy()

    tabela[
        "duracao_segundos"
    ] = (
        tabela["duracao_ms"]
        / 1000
    ).round(3)

    tabela = tabela.drop(
        columns=["duracao_ms"]
    ).sort_values(
        "criado_em",
        ascending=False,
    )

    tabela = tabela.rename(
        columns={
            "id": "ID",
            "criado_em": "Data",
            "provider": "Provider",
            "modelo": "Modelo",
            "operacao": "Operação",
            "origem": "Origem",
            "usuario_id": "Usuário",
            "trace_id": "Trace",
            "tokens_entrada": "Tokens entrada",
            "tokens_saida": "Tokens saída",
            "tokens_totais": "Tokens totais",
            "custo_total_usd": "Custo USD",
            "sucesso": "Sucesso",
            "erro_tipo": "Tipo do erro",
            "duracao_segundos": "Duração (s)",
        }
    )

    tabela["Sucesso"] = tabela[
        "Sucesso"
    ].map(
        {
            True: llm_detail_t("success"),
            False: llm_detail_t("failure"),
        }
    ).fillna(
        llm_detail_t("no_data")
    )

    tabela["Tipo do erro"] = tabela[
        "Tipo do erro"
    ].fillna("—").replace(
        {
            "": "—",
            "None": "—",
            "nan": "—",
        }
    )

    st.dataframe(
        estilizar_tabela_detalhada_llm(
            tabela
        ),
        use_container_width=True,
        hide_index=True,
        height=460,
        column_config={
            "ID": (
                st.column_config.NumberColumn(
                    "ID",
                    format="%d",
                    width="small",
                )
            ),
            "Data": (
                st.column_config.DatetimeColumn(
                    llm_detail_t("date"),
                    format="DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm:ss",
                    width="medium",
                )
            ),
            "Provider": (
                st.column_config.TextColumn(
                    llm_detail_t("provider"),
                    help=llm_detail_t(
                        "provider_help"
                    ),
                    width="medium",
                )
            ),
            "Modelo": (
                st.column_config.TextColumn(
                    llm_table_t("model"),
                    width="large",
                )
            ),
            "Operação": (
                st.column_config.TextColumn(
                    llm_cost_page_t(
                        "operation_column"
                    ),
                    width="large",
                )
            ),
            "Origem": (
                st.column_config.TextColumn(
                    llm_detail_t("origin"),
                    width="medium",
                )
            ),
            "Usuário": (
                st.column_config.TextColumn(
                    llm_detail_t("user"),
                    width="large",
                )
            ),
            "Trace": (
                st.column_config.TextColumn(
                    llm_detail_t("trace"),
                    help=llm_detail_t(
                        "trace_help"
                    ),
                    width="large",
                )
            ),
            "Tokens entrada": (
                st.column_config.NumberColumn(
                    llm_detail_t("input_tokens"),
                    format="%d",
                    width="small",
                )
            ),
            "Tokens saída": (
                st.column_config.NumberColumn(
                    llm_detail_t("output_tokens"),
                    format="%d",
                    width="small",
                )
            ),
            "Tokens totais": (
                st.column_config.NumberColumn(
                    llm_detail_t("total_tokens"),
                    format="%d",
                    width="small",
                )
            ),
            "Custo USD": (
                st.column_config.NumberColumn(
                    llm_detail_t("estimated_cost"),
                    format="US$ %.6f",
                    width="medium",
                )
            ),
            "Duração (s)": (
                st.column_config.NumberColumn(
                    llm_detail_t("duration"),
                    format="%.3f s",
                    width="small",
                )
            ),
            "Sucesso": (
                st.column_config.TextColumn(
                    llm_detail_t("result"),
                    width="medium",
                )
            ),
            "Tipo do erro": (
                st.column_config.TextColumn(
                    llm_detail_t("error_type"),
                    width="large",
                )
            ),
        },
    )


    csv = tabela.to_csv(
        index=False,
    ).encode("utf-8-sig")

    st.download_button(
        llm_cost_page_t(
            "download_csv"
        ),
        data=csv,
        file_name="inna_llm_consumo.csv",
        mime="text/csv",
        use_container_width=True,
        key="llm_cost_download",
    )

    with st.expander(
        llm_cost_page_t(
            "telemetry_privacy"
        ),
        expanded=False,
    ):
        st.markdown(
            llm_cost_page_t(
                "telemetry_text"
            )
        )

    "render_alertas_llm_section",
    "preparar_consumo_exibicao",
    "resumir_consumo_llm",
    "render_llm_costs_page",
]

def timeline_lang() -> str:
    language = str(
        st.session_state.get(
            "dashboard_interface_lang",
            "pt",
        )
    )

    aliases = {
        "en": "en_us",
        "en-US": "en_us",
        "en-GB": "en_gb",
        "ar": "sa",
        "ar-SA": "sa",
    }

    language = aliases.get(
        language,
        language,
    )

    if language in TIMELINE_TEXTS:
        return language

    return "pt"


def timeline_t(
    key: str,
    default: str | None = None,
) -> str:
    language = timeline_lang()

    language_texts = TIMELINE_TEXTS.get(
        language,
        {},
    )

    if key in language_texts:
        return language_texts[key]

    if key in TIMELINE_TEXTS["pt"]:
        return TIMELINE_TEXTS["pt"][key]

    if default is not None:
        return default

    return key



def aplicar_tema_timeline_chart(
    fig,
    *,
    height=440,
):
    """Aplica o tema visual do Timeline Viewer."""
    fig.update_layout(
        template="plotly_dark",
        paper_bgcolor=TIMELINE_CHART_BG,
        plot_bgcolor=TIMELINE_CHART_BG,
        font={
            "color": TIMELINE_CHART_TEXT,
            "family": "Arial",
        },
        hoverlabel={
            "bgcolor": "#0F172A",
            "font_color": TIMELINE_CHART_TEXT,
        },
        margin={
            "l": 30,
            "r": 55,
            "t": 22,
            "b": 42,
        },
        height=height,
    )

    fig.update_xaxes(
        color=TIMELINE_CHART_TEXT,
        gridcolor=TIMELINE_CHART_GRID,
        zerolinecolor=(
            "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25)"
        ),
    )

    fig.update_yaxes(
        color=TIMELINE_CHART_TEXT,
        gridcolor=TIMELINE_CHART_GRID,
        zerolinecolor=(
            "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25)"
        ),
    )

    return fig


def timeline_status_labels() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {
        "sucesso": timeline_t("success"),
        "falha": timeline_t("failure"),
        "ignorado": timeline_t("skipped"),
        "iniciado": timeline_t("started"),
    }

TIMELINE_DYNAMIC_TEXTS["en_gb"] = (
    TIMELINE_DYNAMIC_TEXTS["en_us"]
)

TIMELINE_DYNAMIC_TEXTS["ch"] = (
    TIMELINE_DYNAMIC_TEXTS["de"]
)


def timeline_translate_step(
    value: Any,
) -> str:
    if value is None or pd.isna(value):
        return ""

    original = str(value).strip()
    language = timeline_lang()

    texts = TIMELINE_DYNAMIC_TEXTS.get(
        language,
        TIMELINE_DYNAMIC_TEXTS["pt"],
    )

    return texts["steps"].get(
        original,
        original,
    )


def timeline_translate_message(
    value: Any,
) -> str:
    if value is None or pd.isna(value):
        return ""

    original = str(value).strip()
    language = timeline_lang()

    texts = TIMELINE_DYNAMIC_TEXTS.get(
        language,
        TIMELINE_DYNAMIC_TEXTS["pt"],
    )

    exact_messages = {
        "Pergunta recebida pelo fluxo RAG.": (
            texts["question_received_rag"]
        ),
        "Resposta final preparada para entrega ao dashboard.": (
            texts["final_response_ready"]
        ),
        (
            "Resultado da Tool registrado. O tempo total foi "
            "contabilizado na etapa do Router/Orquestrador."
        ): texts["tool_result"],
    }

    if original in exact_messages:
        return exact_messages[original]

    prefix = "Etapa concluída com sucesso: "

    if (
        original.startswith(prefix)
        and original.endswith(".")
    ):
        step = original[
            len(prefix):-1
        ]

        return texts["step_completed"].format(
            step=timeline_translate_step(step)
        )

    suffix = " concluída com sucesso."

    if original.endswith(suffix):
        step = original[
            :-len(suffix)
        ]

        return texts["completed"].format(
            step=timeline_translate_step(step)
        )

    return original


def formatar_duracao_ms(
    valor: Any,
) -> str:
    """
    Formata duração em ms ou segundos.
    """
    if valor is None or pd.isna(valor):
        return timeline_t(
            "not_measured"
        )

    duracao = float(valor)

    if duracao >= 1000:
        return f"{duracao / 1000:.3f} s"

    return f"{duracao:.3f} ms"


def calcular_resumo_trace(
    df: pd.DataFrame | None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Calcula os indicadores principais de um trace.
    """
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return {
            "total_etapas": 0,
            "total_falhas": 0,
            "total_ignoradas": 0,
            "duracao_total_ms": 0.0,
            "etapa_mais_lenta": None,
            "duracao_etapa_mais_lenta_ms": 0.0,
            "possivel_cold_start": False,
        }

    base = df.copy()

    duracoes = pd.to_numeric(
        base.get(
            "duracao_ms",
            pd.Series(dtype=float),
        ),
        errors="coerce",
    )

    duracao_total = float(
        duracoes.fillna(0).sum()
    )

    etapa_mais_lenta = None
    duracao_mais_lenta = 0.0

    if duracoes.notna().any():
        indice = duracoes.idxmax()

        etapa_mais_lenta = base.loc[
            indice,
            "etapa_label",
        ]

        duracao_mais_lenta = float(
            duracoes.loc[indice]
        )

    total_falhas = int(
        (
            base.get(
                "status",
                pd.Series(dtype=str),
            )
            == "falha"
        ).sum()
    )

    total_ignoradas = int(
        (
            base.get(
                "status",
                pd.Series(dtype=str),
            )
            == "ignorado"
        ).sum()
    )

    return {
        "total_etapas": len(base),
        "total_falhas": total_falhas,
        "total_ignoradas": total_ignoradas,
        "duracao_total_ms": round(
            duracao_total,
            3,
        ),
        "etapa_mais_lenta": etapa_mais_lenta,
        "duracao_etapa_mais_lenta_ms": round(
            duracao_mais_lenta,
            3,
        ),
        "possivel_cold_start": (
            duracao_total >= 30000
        ),
    }


def preparar_traces_exibicao(
    df: pd.DataFrame | None,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Prepara a tabela de traces recentes.
    """
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    tabela = df.copy()

    tabela["Início"] = pd.to_datetime(
        tabela["inicio_trace"],
        errors="coerce",
    ).dt.strftime(
        "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S"
    )

    tabela["Duração total"] = tabela[
        "duracao_total_ms"
    ].apply(
        formatar_duracao_ms
    )

    tabela["Status"] = tabela[
        "total_falhas"
    ].apply(
        lambda total: (
            timeline_t("with_failure")
            if int(total or 0) > 0
            else timeline_t("success")
        )
    )

    tabela["Cold start"] = tabela[
        "duracao_total_ms"
    ].apply(
        lambda valor: (
            timeline_t("possible")
            if float(valor or 0) >= 30000
            else timeline_t("no")
        )
    )

    colunas = [
        "trace_id",
        "Início",
        "usuario_id",
        "pergunta",
        "total_etapas",
        "total_falhas",
        "Duração total",
        "Cold start",
        "origem",
        "Status",
    ]

    return tabela[
        [
            coluna
            for coluna in colunas
            if coluna in tabela.columns
        ]
    ].rename(
        columns={
            "trace_id": "Trace ID",
            "usuario_id": "Usuário",
            "pergunta": "Pergunta",
            "total_etapas": "Etapas",
            "total_falhas": "Falhas",
            "origem": "Origem",
        }
    )


def preparar_timeline_exibicao(
    df: pd.DataFrame | None,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Prepara as etapas de um trace.
    """
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    tabela = df.copy()

    tabela["etapa_label"] = tabela[
        "etapa_label"
    ].map(
        timeline_translate_step
    )

    if "mensagem" in tabela.columns:
        tabela["mensagem"] = tabela[
            "mensagem"
        ].map(
            timeline_translate_message
        )

    tabela["Status visual"] = tabela[
        "status"
    ].map(
        timeline_status_labels()
    ).fillna(
        tabela["status"]
    )

    tabela["Duração"] = tabela[
        "duracao_ms"
    ].apply(
        formatar_duracao_ms
    )

    tabela["Início"] = pd.to_datetime(
        tabela["inicio_em"],
        errors="coerce",
    ).dt.strftime(
        "%H:%M:%S.%f"
    ).str[:-3]

    colunas = [
        "ordem",
        "etapa_label",
        "Status visual",
        "Duração",
        "Início",
        "mensagem",
        "erro",
    ]

    return tabela[
        [
            coluna
            for coluna in colunas
            if coluna in tabela.columns
        ]
    ].rename(
        columns={
            "ordem": "Ordem",
            "etapa_label": "Etapa",
            "mensagem": "Mensagem",
            "erro": "Erro",
        }
    )


def render_etapas_timeline(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:
    """
    Renderiza a sequência visual das etapas.
    """
    for _, evento in df.sort_values(
        by=[
            "ordem",
            "criado_em",
        ]
    ).iterrows():

        status = str(
            evento.get("status")
            or ""
        )

        simbolo = {
            "sucesso": "✅",
            "falha": "❌",
            "ignorado": "⏭️",
            "iniciado": "🔄",
        }.get(
            status,
            "ℹ️",
        )

        etapa = timeline_translate_step(
            evento.get(
                "etapa_label"
            )
        )

        duracao = formatar_duracao_ms(
            evento.get("duracao_ms")
        )

        with st.container(
            border=True
        ):
            col_1, col_2, col_3 = st.columns(
                [0.5, 3, 1.2]
            )

            col_1.markdown(
                f"### {simbolo}"
            )

            col_2.markdown(
                f"**{etapa}**"
            )

            col_2.caption(
                timeline_translate_message(
                    evento.get(
                        "mensagem"
                    )
                )
            )

            col_3.metric(
                timeline_t("duration"),
                duracao,
            )

            erro = evento.get("erro")

            if erro and not pd.isna(erro):
                st.error(
                    str(erro)
                )

            metadata = evento.get(
                "metadata"
            )

            if metadata:
                with st.popover(
                    timeline_t(
                        "view_metadata"
                    )
                ):
                    if isinstance(
                        metadata,
                        str,
                    ):
                        try:
                            metadata = json.loads(
                                metadata
                            )
                        except Exception:
                            pass

                    st.json(
                        metadata
                    )


def calcular_diferenca_traces(
    duracao_a_ms: float,
    duracao_b_ms: float,
) -> dict[str, float]:
    """
    Calcula diferença absoluta e percentual entre traces.

    O percentual usa o Trace A como referência.
    """
    duracao_a = float(
        duracao_a_ms or 0
    )

    duracao_b = float(
        duracao_b_ms or 0
    )

    diferenca_absoluta = (
        duracao_b - duracao_a
    )

    diferenca_percentual = (
        (
            diferenca_absoluta
            / duracao_a
        )
        * 100
        if duracao_a > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    return {
        "diferenca_absoluta_ms": round(
            diferenca_absoluta,
            3,
        ),
        "diferenca_percentual": round(
            diferenca_percentual,
            2,
        ),
    }


def render_comparacao_traces(
    traces_df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:
    """
    Compara dois traces com filtro de cold start,
    escala selecionável e diferença percentual.
    """
    if traces_df is None or len(traces_df) < 2:
        st.info(
            timeline_t(
                "minimum_two_traces"
            )
        )
        return

    base = traces_df.copy()

    ignorar_cold_start = st.checkbox(
        timeline_t(
            "ignore_cold_start"
        ),
        value=False,
        key="timeline_compare_ignore_cold_start",
    )

    if ignorar_cold_start:
        base = base[
            pd.to_numeric(
                base["duracao_total_ms"],
                errors="coerce",
            ).fillna(0) < 30000
        ]

    if len(base) < 2:
        st.warning(
            timeline_t(
                "not_enough_after_filter"
            )
        )
        return

    escala = st.radio(
        timeline_t("chart_scale"),
        options=[
            "linear",
            "logarithmic",
        ],
        format_func=lambda value: (
            timeline_t(value)
        ),
        horizontal=True,
        key="timeline_compare_scale",
    )

    opcoes = base[
        "trace_id"
    ].astype(str).tolist()

    col_1, col_2 = st.columns(2)

    trace_a = col_1.selectbox(
        "Trace A",
        options=opcoes,
        index=0,
        key="timeline_compare_a",
    )

    trace_b = col_2.selectbox(
        "Trace B",
        options=opcoes,
        index=min(
            1,
            len(opcoes) - 1,
        ),
        key="timeline_compare_b",
    )

    if trace_a == trace_b:
        st.warning(
            timeline_t(
                "different_traces"
            )
        )
        return

    try:
        from observability.timeline import (
            carregar_timeline_trace,
        )
    except ImportError:
        from src.observability.timeline import (
            carregar_timeline_trace,
        )

    resultado_a = carregar_timeline_trace(
        trace_a
    )

    resultado_b = carregar_timeline_trace(
        trace_b
    )

    df_a = resultado_a.get("df")
    df_b = resultado_b.get("df")

    resumo_a = calcular_resumo_trace(
        df_a
    )

    resumo_b = calcular_resumo_trace(
        df_b
    )

    duracao_a = float(
        resumo_a["duracao_total_ms"]
    )

    duracao_b = float(
        resumo_b["duracao_total_ms"]
    )

    diferenca = calcular_diferenca_traces(
        duracao_a,
        duracao_b,
    )

    diferenca_absoluta = diferenca[
        "diferenca_absoluta_ms"
    ]

    diferenca_percentual = diferenca[
        "diferenca_percentual"
    ]

    comparacao = pd.DataFrame([
        {
            "Trace": "A",
            "Trace ID": trace_a,
            "Etapas": resumo_a[
                "total_etapas"
            ],
            "Falhas": resumo_a[
                "total_falhas"
            ],
            "Duração total": (
                formatar_duracao_ms(
                    duracao_a
                )
            ),
            "Etapa mais lenta": (
                timeline_translate_step(
                    resumo_a[
                        "etapa_mais_lenta"
                    ]
                )
            ),
            "Cold start": (
                timeline_t(
                    "possible"
                )
                if resumo_a[
                    "possivel_cold_start"
                ]
                else timeline_t(
                    "no"
                )
            ),
        },
        {
            "Trace": "B",
            "Trace ID": trace_b,
            "Etapas": resumo_b[
                "total_etapas"
            ],
            "Falhas": resumo_b[
                "total_falhas"
            ],
            "Duração total": (
                formatar_duracao_ms(
                    duracao_b
                )
            ),
            "Etapa mais lenta": (
                timeline_translate_step(
                    resumo_b[
                        "etapa_mais_lenta"
                    ]
                )
            ),
            "Cold start": (
                timeline_t(
                    "possible"
                )
                if resumo_b[
                    "possivel_cold_start"
                ]
                else timeline_t(
                    "no"
                )
            ),
        },
    ])

    comparacao_exibicao = comparacao.rename(
        columns={
            "Etapas": timeline_t(
                "steps"
            ),
            "Falhas": timeline_t(
                "failures"
            ),
            "Duração total": timeline_t(
                "total_duration"
            ),
            "Etapa mais lenta": timeline_t(
                "slowest_step_column"
            ),
            "Cold start": timeline_t(
                "cold_start"
            ),
        }
    )

    st.dataframe(
        comparacao_exibicao,
        use_container_width=True,
        hide_index=True,
    )

    if diferenca_percentual > 0:
        st.warning(
            timeline_t(
                "trace_b_slower"
            ).format(
                percent=abs(
                    diferenca_percentual
                )
            )
        )

    elif diferenca_percentual < 0:
        st.success(
            timeline_t(
                "trace_b_faster"
            ).format(
                percent=abs(
                    diferenca_percentual
                )
            )
        )

    else:
        st.info(
            timeline_t(
                "same_duration"
            )
        )

    col_delta_1, col_delta_2 = st.columns(2)

    col_delta_1.metric(
        timeline_t(
            "absolute_difference"
        ),
        formatar_duracao_ms(
            abs(diferenca_absoluta)
        ),
    )

    col_delta_2.metric(
        timeline_t(
            "percentage_difference"
        ),
        f"{abs(diferenca_percentual):.2f}%",
    )

    etapas_a = (
        df_a[
            [
                "etapa_label",
                "duracao_ms",
            ]
        ]
        .rename(
            columns={
                "duracao_ms": "Trace A",
            }
        )
    )

    etapas_b = (
        df_b[
            [
                "etapa_label",
                "duracao_ms",
            ]
        ]
        .rename(
            columns={
                "duracao_ms": "Trace B",
            }
        )
    )

    grafico = etapas_a.merge(
        etapas_b,
        on="etapa_label",
        how="outer",
    ).fillna(0)

    grafico["etapa_label"] = grafico[
        "etapa_label"
    ].map(
        timeline_translate_step
    )

    grafico["Trace A"] = pd.to_numeric(
        grafico["Trace A"],
        errors="coerce",
    ).fillna(0)

    grafico["Trace B"] = pd.to_numeric(
        grafico["Trace B"],
        errors="coerce",
    ).fillna(0)

    if escala == "logarithmic":
        import numpy as np

        grafico_plot = grafico.copy()

        grafico_plot["Trace A"] = np.log10(
            grafico_plot["Trace A"] + 1
        )

        grafico_plot["Trace B"] = np.log10(
            grafico_plot["Trace B"] + 1
        )

        st.caption(
            timeline_t(
                "log_caption"
            )
        )
    else:
        grafico_plot = grafico

    grafico_real_longo = grafico.melt(
        id_vars="etapa_label",
        value_vars=[
            "Trace A",
            "Trace B",
        ],
        var_name="Trace",
        value_name="Duracao_real_ms",
    )

    grafico_plot_longo = grafico_plot.melt(
        id_vars="etapa_label",
        value_vars=[
            "Trace A",
            "Trace B",
        ],
        var_name="Trace",
        value_name="Valor_grafico",
    )

    grafico_longo = grafico_plot_longo.merge(
        grafico_real_longo,
        on=[
            "etapa_label",
            "Trace",
        ],
        how="left",
    )

    grafico_longo[
        "Duração formatada"
    ] = grafico_longo[
        "Duracao_real_ms"
    ].map(formatar_duracao_ms)

    ordem_etapas = (
        grafico.assign(
            duracao_maxima=grafico[
                [
                    "Trace A",
                    "Trace B",
                ]
            ].max(axis=1)
        )
        .sort_values(
            "duracao_maxima",
            ascending=True,
        )["etapa_label"]
        .tolist()
    )

    fig_comparacao = px.bar(
        grafico_longo,
        x="Valor_grafico",
        y="etapa_label",
        color="Trace",
        orientation="h",
        barmode="group",
        text="Duração formatada",
        custom_data=[
            "Duração formatada",
            "Duracao_real_ms",
        ],
        color_discrete_map={
            "Trace A": "#38BDF8",
            "Trace B": "#A78BFA",
        },
    )

    fig_comparacao.update_traces(
        textposition="outside",
        cliponaxis=False,
        marker_line_width=0,
        hovertemplate=(
            "<b>%{y}</b><br>"
            "%{fullData.name}: "
            "%{customdata[0]}"
            "<extra></extra>"
        ),
    )

    titulo_eixo = (
        timeline_t("log_axis")
        if escala == "logarithmic"
        else timeline_t(
            "duration_axis"
        )
    )

    fig_comparacao.update_layout(
        xaxis_title=titulo_eixo,
        yaxis_title=None,
        legend_title_text=None,
        legend={
            "orientation": "h",
            "yanchor": "bottom",
            "y": 1.02,
            "xanchor": "center",
            "x": 0.5,
        },
    )

    fig_comparacao.update_yaxes(
        categoryorder="array",
        categoryarray=ordem_etapas,
    )

    aplicar_tema_timeline_chart(
        fig_comparacao,
        height=max(
            420,
            150 + len(ordem_etapas) * 62,
        ),
    )

    st.plotly_chart(
        fig_comparacao,
        width="stretch",
        key="timeline_trace_comparison_chart",
        config={
            "displayModeBar": False,
            "responsive": True,
        },
    )

def render_timeline_viewer_page() -> None:
    """
    Renderiza o Timeline Viewer.
    """
    try:
        from observability.timeline import (
            carregar_timeline_trace,
            carregar_traces_recentes,
        )
    except ImportError:
        from src.observability.timeline import (
            carregar_timeline_trace,
            carregar_traces_recentes,
        )

    st.title(
        timeline_t("page_title")
    )

    st.caption(
        timeline_t("page_caption")
    )

    col_1, col_2 = st.columns(
        [1, 3]
    )

    limite = col_1.selectbox(
        timeline_t("trace_quantity"),
        options=[
            10,
            25,
            50,
            100,
        ],
        index=1,
        key="timeline_viewer_limit",
    )

    with col_2:
        st.write("")

        if st.button(
            timeline_t("refresh"),
            use_container_width=True,
            key="timeline_viewer_refresh",
        ):
            st.rerun()

    resultado_traces = carregar_traces_recentes(
        limite=int(limite)
    )

    if not resultado_traces.get("ok"):
        st.error(
            resultado_traces.get(
                "message"
            )
        )
        return

    traces_df = resultado_traces.get(
        "df"
    )

    if traces_df is None or traces_df.empty:
        st.info(
            timeline_t("no_traces")
        )
        return

    st.markdown(
        timeline_t("search_filters")
    )

    pesquisa = st.text_input(
        timeline_t("search_label"),
        placeholder=timeline_t(
            "search_placeholder"
        ),
        key="timeline_viewer_search",
    )

    filtro_1, filtro_2 = st.columns(2)

    usuarios = sorted(
        traces_df["usuario_id"]
        .dropna()
        .astype(str)
        .unique()
        .tolist()
    )

    origens = sorted(
        traces_df["origem"]
        .dropna()
        .astype(str)
        .unique()
        .tolist()
    )

    usuario = filtro_1.selectbox(
        timeline_t("user"),
        options=["__all__"] + usuarios,
        format_func=lambda value: (
            timeline_t("all_masculine")
            if value == "__all__"
            else value
        ),
        key="timeline_viewer_user",
    )

    origem = filtro_2.selectbox(
        timeline_t("origin"),
        options=["__all__"] + origens,
        format_func=lambda value: (
            timeline_t("all_feminine")
            if value == "__all__"
            else value
        ),
        key="timeline_viewer_origin",
    )

    somente_falhas = st.checkbox(
        timeline_t("only_failures"),
        value=False,
        key="timeline_viewer_failures",
    )

    filtrado = traces_df.copy()

    if pesquisa.strip():
        termo = pesquisa.strip().lower()

        mascara = (
            filtrado["trace_id"]
            .astype(str)
            .str.lower()
            .str.contains(
                termo,
                regex=False,
            )
        )

        for coluna in [
            "usuario_id",
            "pergunta",
        ]:
            if coluna in filtrado.columns:
                mascara = mascara | (
                    filtrado[coluna]
                    .fillna("")
                    .astype(str)
                    .str.lower()
                    .str.contains(
                        termo,
                        regex=False,
                    )
                )

        filtrado = filtrado[
            mascara
        ]

    if usuario != "__all__":
        filtrado = filtrado[
            filtrado["usuario_id"].astype(str)
            == usuario
        ]

    if origem != "__all__":
        filtrado = filtrado[
            filtrado["origem"].astype(str)
            == origem
        ]

    if somente_falhas:
        filtrado = filtrado[
            filtrado["total_falhas"] > 0
        ]

    st.caption(
        timeline_t(
            "traces_found"
        ).format(
            count=len(filtrado)
        )
    )

    st.markdown(
        timeline_t("recent_traces")
    )

    traces_exibicao = (
        preparar_traces_exibicao(
            filtrado
        ).rename(
            columns={
                "Início": timeline_t(
                    "start"
                ),
                "Usuário": timeline_t(
                    "user"
                ),
                "Pergunta": timeline_t(
                    "question"
                ).removeprefix("### "),
                "Etapas": timeline_t(
                    "steps"
                ),
                "Falhas": timeline_t(
                    "failures"
                ),
                "Duração total": timeline_t(
                    "total_duration"
                ),
                "Cold start": timeline_t(
                    "cold_start"
                ),
                "Origem": timeline_t(
                    "origin"
                ),
                "Status": timeline_t(
                    "status"
                ),
            }
        )
    )

    st.dataframe(
        traces_exibicao,
        use_container_width=True,
        hide_index=True,
    )

    if filtrado.empty:
        return

    opcoes_trace = filtrado[
        "trace_id"
    ].astype(str).tolist()

    trace_selecionado = st.selectbox(
        timeline_t("select_trace"),
        options=opcoes_trace,
        key="timeline_viewer_trace",
    )

    resultado_timeline = (
        carregar_timeline_trace(
            trace_selecionado
        )
    )

    if not resultado_timeline.get("ok"):
        st.error(
            resultado_timeline.get(
                "message"
            )
        )
        return

    timeline_df = resultado_timeline.get(
        "df"
    )

    resumo = calcular_resumo_trace(
        timeline_df
    )

    st.divider()
    st.markdown(
        timeline_t("execution_summary")
    )

    linha_1 = st.columns(4)

    linha_1[0].metric(
        timeline_t("steps"),
        resumo["total_etapas"],
    )

    linha_1[1].metric(
        timeline_t("failures"),
        resumo["total_falhas"],
    )

    linha_1[2].metric(
        timeline_t("ignored"),
        resumo["total_ignoradas"],
    )

    linha_1[3].metric(
        timeline_t("total_duration"),
        formatar_duracao_ms(
            resumo["duracao_total_ms"]
        ),
    )

    if resumo["possivel_cold_start"]:
        st.warning(
            timeline_t(
                "cold_start_warning"
            )
        )
    else:
        st.success(
            timeline_t(
                "execution_ok"
            )
        )

    if resumo["etapa_mais_lenta"]:
        duracao_etapa_mais_lenta = (
            formatar_duracao_ms(
                resumo[
                    "duracao_etapa_mais_lenta_ms"
                ]
            )
        )

        st.info(
            timeline_t("slowest_step")
            + ": "
            + timeline_translate_step(
                resumo["etapa_mais_lenta"]
            )
            + " — "
            + duracao_etapa_mais_lenta
        )

    pergunta = (
        timeline_df["pergunta"]
        .dropna()
        .astype(str)
    )

    if not pergunta.empty:
        st.markdown(
            timeline_t("question")
        )

        st.code(
            pergunta.iloc[0],
            language=None,
        )

    st.markdown(
        timeline_t("execution_path")
    )

    render_etapas_timeline(
        timeline_df
    )

    st.markdown(
        timeline_t("technical_table")
    )

    timeline_exibicao = (
        preparar_timeline_exibicao(
            timeline_df
        ).rename(
            columns={
                "Ordem": timeline_t(
                    "order"
                ),
                "Etapa": timeline_t(
                    "step"
                ),
                "Status visual": timeline_t(
                    "status"
                ),
                "Duração": timeline_t(
                    "duration"
                ),
                "Início": timeline_t(
                    "start"
                ),
                "Mensagem": timeline_t(
                    "message"
                ),
                "Erro": timeline_t(
                    "error"
                ),
            }
        )
    )

    st.dataframe(
        timeline_exibicao,
        use_container_width=True,
        hide_index=True,
    )

    st.divider()
    st.markdown(
        timeline_t("compare_traces")
    )

    render_comparacao_traces(
        traces_df
    )

def aplicar_tema_llmops_chart(
    fig,
    *,
    height=440,
):
    """Aplica o tema visual do INNA LLMOps."""
    fig.update_layout(
        template="plotly_dark",
        paper_bgcolor=LLMOPS_CHART_BG,
        plot_bgcolor=LLMOPS_CHART_BG,
        font={
            "color": LLMOPS_CHART_TEXT,
            "family": "Arial",
        },
        hoverlabel={
            "bgcolor": "#0F172A",
            "font_color": LLMOPS_CHART_TEXT,
        },
        margin={
            "l": 38,
            "r": 28,
            "t": 25,
            "b": 48,
        },
        height=height,
    )

    fig.update_xaxes(
        color=LLMOPS_CHART_TEXT,
        gridcolor=LLMOPS_CHART_GRID,
        zerolinecolor=(
            "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25)"
        ),
    )

    fig.update_yaxes(
        color=LLMOPS_CHART_TEXT,
        gridcolor=LLMOPS_CHART_GRID,
        zerolinecolor=(
            "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25)"
        ),
    )

    return fig

def llmops_lang() -> str:
    idioma = st.session_state.get(
        "dashboard_interface_lang",
        "pt",
    )

    if idioma in LLMOPS_TEXTS:
        return idioma

    return "pt"


def llmops_t(
    key: str,
    default: str | None = None,
) -> str:
    idioma = llmops_lang()

    return LLMOPS_TEXTS.get(
        idioma,
        LLMOPS_TEXTS["pt"],
    ).get(
        key,
        default or key,
    )

def llmops_column_labels() -> dict[str, str]:
    idioma = llmops_lang()

    return LLMOPS_COLUMN_TEXTS.get(
        idioma,
        LLMOPS_COLUMN_TEXTS["pt"],
    )


def traduzir_colunas_llmops(
    frame: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return frame.rename(
        columns=llmops_column_labels()
    )


def _percentage(
    value: float | None,
) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return "—"

    return f"{value:.2%}"


def _render_header() -> None:
    st.title(
        llmops_t("title")
    )

    st.caption(
        llmops_t("caption")
    )


def _render_infrastructure_status() -> None:
    """
    Exibe a saúde operacional sem revelar
    credenciais ou identificadores privados.
    """

    try:
        initialize_phoenix()
        health = collect_infrastructure_health()
    except Exception as exc:
        st.warning(
            llmops_t("infra_error")
        )

        with st.expander(
            llmops_t("technical_details"),
            expanded=False,
        ):
            st.code(type(exc).__name__)

        return

    st.subheader(
        llmops_t("infrastructure_title")
    )

    status_labels = {
        "operational": llmops_t(
            "operational"
        ),
        "degraded": llmops_t(
            "degraded"
        ),
        "unavailable": llmops_t(
            "unavailable"
        ),
    }

    status_label = status_labels.get(
        health.status,
        health.status,
    )

    status_message = (
        f"{llmops_t('general_status')}: "
        f"{status_label}"
    )

    if health.status == "operational":
        st.success(status_message)
    elif health.status == "degraded":
        st.warning(status_message)
    else:
        st.error(status_message)

    neon_column, phoenix_column, render_column = (
        st.columns(3)
    )

    with neon_column:
        st.metric(
            "Neon PostgreSQL",
            (
                llmops_t("available")
                if health.neon.available
                else llmops_t("unavailable")
            ),
            (
                f"{health.neon.latency_ms:.0f} ms"
                if health.neon.latency_ms
                is not None
                else llmops_t(
                    "no_measurement"
                )
            ),
        )

        st.caption(
            f"Pool: {health.neon.pool_status}"
        )

    with phoenix_column:
        st.metric(
            "Phoenix",
            (
                llmops_t("active")
                if health.phoenix.ready
                else llmops_t("inactive")
            ),
            (
                f"{llmops_t('sample')} "
                f"{health.phoenix.sample_rate:.0%}"
            ),
        )

        st.caption(
            f"{llmops_t('project')}: "
            f"{health.phoenix.project_name}"
        )

    with render_column:
        st.metric(
            llmops_t("execution"),
            (
                "Render"
                if health.render.running_on_render
                else llmops_t("local")
            ),
            health.render.environment,
        )

        st.caption(
            f"{llmops_t('service')}: "
            f"{health.render.service_name}"
        )

    with st.expander(
        llmops_t(
            "infrastructure_details"
        ),
        expanded=False,
    ):
        detail_column_1, detail_column_2 = (
            st.columns(2)
        )

        with detail_column_1:
            st.write("**Neon**")

            st.write(
                "PostgreSQL: "
                f"{health.neon.server_version or '—'}"
            )

            st.write(
                f"{llmops_t('pool_size')}: "
                f"{health.neon.pool_size}"
            )

            st.write(
                f"{llmops_t('available_connections')}: "
                f"{health.neon.pool_available}"
            )

            st.write(
                f"{llmops_t('waiting_requests')}: "
                f"{health.neon.pool_waiting}"
            )

        with detail_column_2:
            st.write(
                f"**{llmops_t('application_tracing')}**"
            )

            st.write(
                f"{llmops_t('environment')}: "
                f"{health.render.environment}"
            )

            st.write(
                f"{llmops_t('region')}: "
                f"{health.render.region}"
            )

            st.write(
                f"{llmops_t('phoenix_processor')}: "
                f"{health.phoenix.processor}"
            )

            st.write(
                f"{llmops_t('content_capture')}: "
                f"{health.phoenix.capture_content}"
            )

        if health.unavailable_components:
            st.error(
                f"{llmops_t('unavailable_components')}: "
                + ", ".join(
                    health.unavailable_components
                )
            )

        if health.degraded_components:
            st.warning(
                f"{llmops_t('degraded_components')}: "
                + ", ".join(
                    health.degraded_components
                )
            )

def _render_filters(
    history,
    controls,
):
    controls.header(
        llmops_t("filters")
    )

    available_branches = sorted(
        {
            entry.branch
            for entry in history.entries
        }
    )

    available_environments = sorted(
        {
            entry.environment
            for entry in history.entries
        }
    )

    branches = controls.multiselect(
        llmops_t("branches"),
        available_branches,
        default=available_branches,
    )

    environments = controls.multiselect(
        llmops_t("environments"),
        available_environments,
        default=available_environments,
    )

    status_options = (
        "all",
        "approved",
        "failed",
    )

    status_labels = {
        "all": llmops_t("all_runs"),
        "approved": llmops_t(
            "approved_runs_option"
        ),
        "failed": llmops_t(
            "failed_runs_option"
        ),
    }

    status_option = controls.selectbox(
        llmops_t("run_status"),
        status_options,
        format_func=lambda value: (
            status_labels[value]
        ),
    )

    passed_filter = {
        "all": None,
        "approved": True,
        "failed": False,
    }[status_option]

    selected_branches = (
        set(branches)
        if branches
        else set()
    )

    selected_environments = (
        set(environments)
        if environments
        else set()
    )

    return filter_history(
        history,
        branches=selected_branches,
        environments=selected_environments,
        passed=passed_filter,
    )

def _render_summary(history) -> None:
    summary = build_dashboard_summary(
        history
    )

    first, second, third, fourth = (
        st.columns(4)
    )

    first.metric(
        llmops_t("total_runs"),
        summary.total_runs,
    )

    second.metric(
        llmops_t("approval_rate"),
        _percentage(
            summary.approval_rate
        ),
    )

    third.metric(
        llmops_t("latest_pass_rate"),
        _percentage(
            summary.latest_pass_rate
        ),
    )

    fourth.metric(
        llmops_t("tracked_metrics"),
        summary.tracked_metrics,
    )

    fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth = (
        st.columns(4)
    )

    fifth.metric(
        llmops_t("approved_runs"),
        summary.approved_runs,
    )

    sixth.metric(
        llmops_t("failed_runs"),
        summary.failed_runs,
    )

    seventh.metric(
        llmops_t("recent_regressions"),
        summary.latest_regressions,
    )

    eighth.metric(
        llmops_t("recent_violations"),
        summary.latest_violations,
    )

    if (
        summary.latest_quality_gate_passed
        is True
    ):
        st.success(
            llmops_t("gate_approved")
        )
    elif (
        summary.latest_quality_gate_passed
        is False
    ):
        st.error(
            llmops_t("gate_failed")
        )
    else:
        st.info(
            llmops_t("no_runs")
        )


def _render_pass_rate_chart(history) -> None:
    st.subheader(
        llmops_t("pass_rate_chart")
    )

    rows = build_pass_rate_series(history)

    if not rows:
        st.info(
            llmops_t("no_runs_chart")
        )
        return

    frame = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    frame["recorded_at"] = pd.to_datetime(
        frame["recorded_at"],
        utc=True,
    )

    fig_pass_rate = px.line(
        frame.sort_values("recorded_at"),
        x="recorded_at",
        y="pass_rate",
        markers=True,
        color_discrete_sequence=[
            "#34D399",
        ],
        labels={
            "recorded_at": llmops_t("date"),
            "pass_rate": llmops_t(
                "approval_rate"
            ),
        },
    )

    fig_pass_rate.update_traces(
        line={"width": 3},
        marker={
            "size": 9,
            "color": "#D1FAE5",
            "line": {
                "color": "#34D399",
                "width": 2,
            },
        },
        fill="tozeroy",
        fillcolor="rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.15)",
        hovertemplate=(
            "<b>%{x|%d/%m/%Y %H:%M}</b><br>"
            + llmops_t("approval_rate")
            + ": %{y:.2%}<extra></extra>"
        ),
    )

    fig_pass_rate.update_layout(
        xaxis_title=None,
        yaxis_title=llmops_t(
            "approval_rate"
        ),
        showlegend=False,
        hovermode="x unified",
    )

    fig_pass_rate.update_xaxes(
        tickformat="%d/%m<br>%H:%M",
    )

    fig_pass_rate.update_yaxes(
        range=[0, 1],
        tickformat=".0%",
    )

    aplicar_tema_llmops_chart(
        fig_pass_rate,
        height=430,
    )

    st.plotly_chart(
        fig_pass_rate,
        width="stretch",
        key="llmops_pass_rate_evolution_chart",
        config={
            "displayModeBar": False,
            "responsive": True,
        },
    )

def _render_metric_chart(history) -> None:
    st.subheader(
        llmops_t("metric_trend_chart")
    )

    available_metrics = get_metric_ids(
        history
    )

    if not available_metrics:
        st.info(
            llmops_t("no_metrics")
        )
        return

    selected_metrics = st.multiselect(
        llmops_t("displayed_metrics"),
        available_metrics,
        default=list(
            available_metrics[:5]
        ),
    )

    if not selected_metrics:
        st.warning(
            llmops_t("select_metric")
        )
        return

    rows = build_metric_series(
        history,
        metric_ids=set(selected_metrics),
    )

    frame = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    if frame.empty:
        st.info(
            llmops_t("no_metric_data")
        )
        return

    frame["recorded_at"] = pd.to_datetime(
        frame["recorded_at"],
        utc=True,
    )

    pivot = frame.pivot_table(
        index="recorded_at",
        columns="metric_id",
        values="average_score",
        aggfunc="last",
    ).sort_index()

    metricas_disponiveis = list(
        pivot.columns
    )

    metricas_plot = pivot.reset_index()

    fig_metricas = px.line(
        metricas_plot,
        x="recorded_at",
        y=metricas_disponiveis,
        markers=True,
        color_discrete_sequence=(
            LLMOPS_METRIC_COLORS
        ),
        labels={
            "recorded_at": llmops_t("date"),
            "value": llmops_t(
                "average_score"
            ),
            "variable": llmops_t("metric"),
        },
    )

    fig_metricas.update_traces(
        line={"width": 2.7},
        marker={"size": 7},
        connectgaps=False,
        hovertemplate=(
            "<b>%{x|%d/%m/%Y %H:%M}</b><br>"
            "%{fullData.name}: %{y:.2%}"
            "<extra></extra>"
        ),
    )

    fig_metricas.update_layout(
        xaxis_title=None,
        yaxis_title=llmops_t(
            "average_score"
        ),
        legend_title_text=llmops_t(
            "metric"
        ),
        hovermode="x unified",
        legend={
            "orientation": "h",
            "yanchor": "top",
            "y": -0.22,
            "xanchor": "center",
            "x": 0.5,
        },
    )

    fig_metricas.update_xaxes(
        tickformat="%d/%m<br>%H:%M",
    )

    fig_metricas.update_yaxes(
        range=[0, 1],
        tickformat=".0%",
    )

    aplicar_tema_llmops_chart(
        fig_metricas,
        height=510,
    )

    st.plotly_chart(
        fig_metricas,
        width="stretch",
        key="llmops_metrics_trend_chart",
        config={
            "displayModeBar": False,
            "responsive": True,
        },
    )

def _render_latest_snapshot(history) -> None:
    st.subheader(
        llmops_t("latest_snapshot")
    )

    latest = history.latest()

    if latest is None:
        st.info(
            llmops_t("no_registered_run")
        )
        return

    column_labels = llmops_column_labels()

    st.write(
        {
            column_labels["run_reference"]: (
                latest.run_reference
            ),
            column_labels["branch"]: (
                latest.branch
            ),
            column_labels["commit_sha"]: (
                latest.commit_sha
            ),
            column_labels["environment"]: (
                latest.environment
            ),
            column_labels["evaluation_mode"]: (
                latest.evaluation_mode
            ),
            column_labels["baseline_id"]: (
                latest.baseline_id
            ),
            column_labels["recorded_at"]: (
                latest.recorded_at
            ),
        }
    )

    snapshot = build_metric_snapshot(
        latest
    )

    if snapshot:
        frame = pd.DataFrame(snapshot)
        frame = traduzir_colunas_llmops(
            frame
        )

        st.dataframe(
            frame,
            width="stretch",
            hide_index=True,
        )


def _render_runs_table(history) -> None:
    st.subheader(
        llmops_t("runs_history")
    )

    rows = build_runs_table(history)

    if not rows:
        st.info(
            llmops_t("no_filtered_runs")
        )
        return

    frame = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    column_labels = llmops_column_labels()

    st.dataframe(
        frame,
        width="stretch",
        hide_index=True,
        column_config={
            "run_reference": (
                st.column_config.TextColumn(
                    column_labels["run_reference"]
                )
            ),
            "branch": (
                st.column_config.TextColumn(
                    column_labels["branch"]
                )
            ),
            "commit_sha": (
                st.column_config.TextColumn(
                    column_labels["commit_sha"]
                )
            ),
            "environment": (
                st.column_config.TextColumn(
                    column_labels["environment"]
                )
            ),
            "evaluation_mode": (
                st.column_config.TextColumn(
                    column_labels["evaluation_mode"]
                )
            ),
            "baseline_id": (
                st.column_config.TextColumn(
                    column_labels["baseline_id"]
                )
            ),
            "recorded_at": (
                st.column_config.DatetimeColumn(
                    column_labels["recorded_at"]
                )
            ),
            "regressions": (
                st.column_config.NumberColumn(
                    column_labels["regressions"]
                )
            ),
            "violations": (
                st.column_config.NumberColumn(
                    column_labels["violations"]
                )
            ),
            "pass_rate": (
                st.column_config.ProgressColumn(
                    llmops_t("pass_rate"),
                    min_value=0.0,
                    max_value=1.0,
                    format="%.2f",
                )
            ),
            "passed": (
                st.column_config.CheckboxColumn(
                    llmops_t("approved")
                )
            ),
            "quality_gate_passed": (
                st.column_config.CheckboxColumn(
                    llmops_t("quality_gate")
                )
            ),
        },
    )


def render_llmops_dashboard(
    *,
    integrated: bool = False,
) -> None:
    """
    Renderiza o painel LLMOps.

    integrated=False:
        execução Streamlit independente.

    integrated=True:
        execução incorporada ao dashboard
        administrativo principal da INNA.
    """
    _render_header()
    _render_infrastructure_status()

    st.divider()

    if integrated:
        controls = st.expander(
            llmops_t("llmops_filters"),
            expanded=False,
        )
        history_key = (
            "llmops_integrated_history_path"
        )
    else:
        controls = st.sidebar
        history_key = (
            "llmops_standalone_history_path"
        )

    history_path = controls.text_input(
        llmops_t("history_file"),
        str(DEFAULT_HISTORY_PATH),
        key=history_key,
    )

    try:
        history = load_dashboard_history(
            history_path
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        st.error(
            f"{llmops_t('history_load_error')}: "
            f"{exc}"
        )
        return

    filtered_history = _render_filters(
        history,
        controls,
    )

    _render_summary(filtered_history)

    st.divider()

    _render_pass_rate_chart(
        filtered_history
    )

    _render_metric_chart(
        filtered_history
    )

    st.divider()

    _render_latest_snapshot(
        filtered_history
    )

    _render_runs_table(
        filtered_history
    )


def main() -> None:
    st.set_page_config(
        page_title="INNA LLMOps",
        page_icon="📊",
        layout="wide",
    )

    render_llmops_dashboard(
        integrated=False
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
